[BugFix][Model] Normalize Kimi image patches on NPU (#21601)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Add CPU-reference-exact NPU pixel normalization for Kimi-K3/K3.1 image
inputs.
The vision tower receives normalized BF16/FP16 patches before patch
projection
when `mm_device_do_normalize` is enabled.

- Support 14x14 RGB patches with mean/std `[0.5, 0.5, 0.5]`.
- Use one 256-entry lookup table derived from the CPU processor's FP32
reference
and rounded to the projection dtype. All BLOCK variants convert pixel
indices
  with `.to(tl.float16).to(tl.int32)` before Gather.
- Use BLOCK sizes 1024, 4096 and 8192, with programs bounded by the
device's actual
Vector core count. The shared startup registry warms up all three
variants for
  the module's final dtype.
- Read legacy `preprocessor_config.json` media settings even when
`processor_class` is absent and cached image metadata is empty,
preserving
  explicit errors when required normalization settings are missing.
- Keep CPU-normalized inputs on the existing identity path and skip
construction
  for missing vision towers.
- Provide the operator document, Triton inventory entry, nightly tests
and CPU
warmup unit tests. K3/K3.1 deployment examples use device normalization.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Kimi-K3/K3.1 image inputs are normalized on NPU before patch
projection.
Users can use device normalization without forcing CPU preprocessing
through
`--no-mm-device-do-normalize`.

### How was this patch tested?

- PR CI passed at `c81de2ca6b` in [E2E run
43180210371](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/43180210371):
pre-commit, both CPU UT versions, A2/A3 selected tests, upstream tests
and
  `ci-gate` all passed. Documentation link checking also passed.
- CPU warmup unit-test results: 42 cases passed in
`tests/ut/model_executor/warmup/test_jit_warmup_kimi_pixel_norm.py`; 47
passed
together with the RMS and DSpark warmup tests. The launcher fixture
covers
both configured kernels and plain Python function placeholders,
preserving
the first pixel argument in CPU environments without Triton. Coverage
includes registration,
final-dtype compile keys, LUT restoration, metadata-only compilation and
  runtime dispatch boundaries. Compiler and device launches are mocked.
- Processor-metadata regression tests in
`tests/ut/ops/test_kimi_pixel_norm.py`: 5 cases passed, covering legacy
  preprocessor files without `processor_class`, flat/nested processor
configurations, cached metadata and missing-config errors. Before the
fix,
the legacy case reproduced the A3 startup `KeyError: 'media_proc_cfg'`.
Together with the pixel, RMS and DSpark warmup tests, 52 CPU cases
passed.
Both A3 TP4 image startup cases now pass: MRV2's file passed all 5
tests,
  and MRV1's file passed all 4 tests in the run above.
- Recorded A3/A5 hardware validation of this FP16-index kernel: 10
nightly cases
passed on each device, covering BF16/FP16, all pixel values, empty
inputs,
dispatch boundaries, graph replay and dynamic shapes. The standalone
operator
nightly was not rerun for the latest checkout; current model CI is
recorded
  above.
- Real-image validation on each device: 1730 MMMU_Pro requests, 2015
images and
2,735,879,328 BF16 projection-input elements; mismatch count was zero
against
  the actual CPU processor.
- The nightly warmup test rejects runtime compilation after registry
warmup;
  it does not independently establish cold-cache compilation coverage.
- Focused Ruff, Python formatting, Markdown and mypy checks pass.

Recorded C=1 image preprocessing throughput for the FP16-index kernel:

| Hardware | CPU requests/s | NPU requests/s | Throughput gain |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| A3 Ascend910_9382 | 148.93 | 171.62 | 15.24% |
| A5 Ascend950DT_9582 | 126.83 | 159.65 | 25.87% |

The benchmark includes decoded RGB resize/pad/patchify, pinning, H2D and
synchronized BF16 readiness, using one consumer, four Numba threads and
three
alternating CPU/device pairs over the same request order. A5 used a
shared card.
These are preprocessing measurements, not full-model accuracy, TTFT or
generation
throughput results.

Environment: CANN 9.2.1, torch 2.10.0, torch-npu 2.10.0.post7 and
triton-ascend
3.6.0.post2.

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/24420b7a341af37a9bc3186e6fc6062512e0aa58

---------

Signed-off-by: Dawn952 <zhaojunbo13@huawei.com>

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM-Ascend project
+import json
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import numpy as np
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch_npu  # noqa: F401
+from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup import JitWarmupRegistry
+
+from vllm_ascend.ops.kimi_pixel_norm import KimiPixelNormLut, build_kimi_pixel_norm
+from vllm_ascend.ops.triton.kimi_pixel_norm import _kimi_pixel_norm_kernel
+
+
+def _warmup(norm):
+    registry = JitWarmupRegistry(None)
+    with registry.activate():
+        norm.register_warmup()
+    registry.warmup()
+
+
+def _reference():
+    values = np.arange(256, dtype=np.float32)
+    lut = (values / 255.0 - np.float32(0.5)) * (np.float32(1.0) / np.float32(0.5))
+    return torch.from_numpy(lut).reshape(256, 1).expand(-1, 3).contiguous()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.bfloat16, torch.float16])
+def test_pixel_lut_exhaustive_values_boundaries_and_graph(dtype):
+    reference = _reference()
+    device = torch.device("npu", torch.npu.current_device())
+    norm = KimiPixelNormLut(reference, dtype=dtype, device=device)
+    _warmup(norm)
+    for patches in (0, 1, 3, 9, 334, 335, 4096, 4097, 33488):
+        pixels = (torch.arange(patches * 588) % 256).to(torch.uint8).reshape(patches, 3, 14, 14)
+        indices = pixels.long() * 3 + torch.arange(3).reshape(1, 3, 1, 1)
+        expected = reference.flatten()[indices].to(device=device).to(dtype)
+        inputs = pixels.to(device=device)
+        actual = norm(inputs, dtype)
+        assert torch.equal(actual.cpu().view(torch.int16), expected.cpu().view(torch.int16))
+    graph = torch.npu.NPUGraph()
+    with torch.npu.graph(graph):
+        captured = norm(inputs, dtype)
+    graph.replay()
+    assert torch.equal(captured.cpu().view(torch.int16), expected.cpu().view(torch.int16))
+    for value in (127, 255):
+        inputs.fill_(value)
+        graph.replay()
+        expected = reference[value, 0].to(dtype).expand_as(captured.cpu())
+        assert torch.equal(captured.cpu().view(torch.int16), expected.view(torch.int16))
+
+
+def test_pixel_lut_rejects_invalid_layout_and_dtype():
+    device = torch.device("npu", torch.npu.current_device())
+    table = torch.zeros(256, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    cores = torch.npu.get_device_properties(device).vector_core_num
+    op = torch.ops.vllm.kimi_pixel_norm_lut
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="uint8"):
+        op(torch.zeros((1, 588), dtype=torch.float32, device=device), table, cores)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="contiguous"):
+        op(torch.zeros((1, 3, 14, 14), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device).transpose(2, 3), table, cores)
+
+
+def test_dynamic_shapes_share_one_torch_compile_graph():
+    device = torch.device("npu", torch.npu.current_device())
+    reference = _reference()
+    norm = KimiPixelNormLut(reference, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=device)
+    _warmup(norm)
+    graphs = []
+
+    def backend(graph, example_inputs):
+        graphs.append(graph)
+        return graph.forward
+
+    compiled = torch.compile(norm, backend=backend, fullgraph=True, dynamic=True)
+    for patches in (36, 335, 1152, 4097):
+        pixels = torch.zeros((patches, 588), dtype=torch.uint8, device=device)
+        actual = compiled(pixels, torch.bfloat16)

+    with (

+        patch.object(torch, "empty", side_effect=AssertionError("registration must not allocate payloads")),

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM-Ascend project
+"""CPU-reference-exact Triton pixel normalization for Kimi on A3/A5."""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import StageMissingLayer
+from vllm.transformers_utils.processor import get_processor_config
+from vllm.transformers_utils.processors.kimi_k25_vision_fused import KimiK25FusedVisionProcessor
+from vllm.transformers_utils.repo_utils import get_hf_file_to_dict
+
+from vllm_ascend.ops.triton.kimi_pixel_norm import _KIMI_PIXEL_NORM_KERNEL
+
+
+class KimiPixelNormLut(nn.Module):
+    lut: torch.Tensor
+
+    def __init__(self, reference: torch.Tensor, *, dtype: torch.dtype, device: torch.device):
+        super().__init__()
+        if dtype not in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16):
+            raise ValueError("visual dtype must be BF16 or FP16")
+        # The Kimi processor provides the fixed FP32 [256,3] CPU table.
+        # Retain only the two supported 16-bit tables, outside checkpoint state.
+        # Dtype moves restore their exact FP32-reference rounding, never BF16->FP16.
+        self._table_bits = {
+            target: tuple(reference[:, 0].to(target).view(torch.int16).tolist())
+            for target in (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+        }
+        self.register_buffer("lut", torch.empty(0, dtype=dtype, device=device), persistent=False)
+        self._vector_cores = 0
+        self._refresh_table()
+
+    @property
+    def input_dtype(self) -> torch.dtype:
+        return torch.uint8
+
+    def _refresh_table(self) -> None:
+        reference = torch.tensor(self._table_bits[self.lut.dtype], dtype=torch.int16, device="cpu").view(self.lut.dtype)
+        self.lut = reference.to(device=self.lut.device)
+        if self.lut.device.type == "npu":
+            self._vector_cores = int(torch.npu.get_device_properties(self.lut.device).vector_core_num)
+            if self._vector_cores <= 0:
+                raise ValueError("vector core count must be positive")
+
+    def _apply(self, fn, recurse=True):
+        moved = fn(self.lut)
+        if moved.dtype not in self._table_bits:
+            raise ValueError("visual dtype must be BF16 or FP16")
+        self.lut = moved
+        self._refresh_table()
+        return self
+
+    def forward(self, pixels: torch.Tensor, visual_dtype: torch.dtype) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if visual_dtype != self.lut.dtype:
+            raise ValueError("lookup table dtype must match the patch projection dtype")
+        return torch.ops.vllm.kimi_pixel_norm_lut(pixels, self.lut, self._vector_cores)
+
+    def register_warmup(self) -> None:
+        """Register the module for compile-only startup warmup."""
+        _KIMI_PIXEL_NORM_KERNEL.register_warmup(self)
+
+
+def build_kimi_pixel_norm(model_config, vision_tower: nn.Module) -> KimiPixelNormLut | None:
+    if not model_config.multimodal_config.mm_device_do_normalize or isinstance(vision_tower, StageMissingLayer):
+        return None
+    hf_config = model_config.hf_config
+    if hf_config.model_type not in ("kimi_k3", "kimi_k31") or not any(
+        architecture in ("KimiK3ForConditionalGeneration", "KimiK31ForConditionalGeneration")
+        for architecture in hf_config.architectures
+    ):
+        raise ValueError("device pixel normalization is limited to Kimi-K3/K3.1")
+    config = get_processor_config(model_config.model, revision=model_config.revision)
+    config = config.get("image_processor", config)
+    if "media_proc_cfg" not in config:
+        config = model_config.hf_image_processor_config
+    if "media_proc_cfg" not in config:
+        # Legacy preprocessor files need not declare processor_class, so the
+        # processor-class resolver can skip otherwise valid media metadata.
+        config = (
+            get_hf_file_to_dict("preprocessor_config.json", model_config.model, revision=model_config.revision) or {}
+        )
+    media_config = config["media_proc_cfg"]
+    if media_config["patch_size"] != 14:
+        raise ValueError("Kimi pixel LUT currently requires 14x14 RGB patches")
+    if list(media_config["image_mean"]) != [0.5, 0.5, 0.5] or list(media_config["image_std"]) != [0.5, 0.5, 0.5]:
+        raise ValueError("Kimi pixel LUT requires RGB mean/std equal to 0.5")
+    processor = KimiK25FusedVisionProcessor(media_proc_cfg=media_config)
+    projection = vision_tower.patch_embed.proj
+    norm = KimiPixelNormLut(
+        torch.from_numpy(processor.normalize_lut), dtype=projection.weight.dtype, device=projection.weight.device
+    )
+    norm.register_warmup()
+    return norm

+# kimi_pixel_norm
+
+## Description
+
+- **Function**: Converts Kimi uint8 image patches into the BF16/FP16 input of the
+  vision patch projection. `KimiPixelNormLut` is installed by the Kimi-K3/K3.1
+  constructor after the projection device and dtype are known. Other models do
+  not install this module, and missing vision towers skip construction.
+- **Formula**: `output[i] = lut[pixels[i]]`. The CPU processor builds the reference
+  in its original FP32 order, `(value / 255.0 - 0.5) * (1.0 / 0.5)`, before one
+  conversion to the projection dtype. The device kernel only looks up the
+  rounded table entries; it does not reassociate the formula into an affine
+  expression.
+- **Algorithm flow**:
+  1. Select a tile of 1024, 4096 or 8192 scalar elements for small, medium or large
+     inputs. Dispatch boundaries are 196608 and 2408448 elements, corresponding
+     to 334 and 4096 complete patches.
+  2. Start at most the actual number of Vector cores and assign tiles by a
+     grid-stride loop. Every tile uses the same 256-entry table.
+  3. Convert uint8 pixels through FP16 to int32 indices, then gather the
+     corresponding table entries. Every uint8 value is represented exactly by
+     FP16, so the conversion preserves the index and the rounded table value.
+  4. Mask the last tile; empty input returns an empty output without a launch.
+- **Supported modes**: A3 and 950PR&950DT Products, eager execution, dynamic Torch
+  compile and ACL graph capture/replay. Hardware validation used Ascend950DT_9582
+  and Ascend910_9382. A2 has not been validated.
+
+## Parameters
+
+The launch wrapper is `kimi_pixel_norm_lut(pixels, lut, vector_cores)` in
+`vllm_ascend/ops/triton/kimi_pixel_norm.py`.
+
+| Parameter | Input/Output/Attribute | Description | Data type | Data format |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| `pixels` | Input | Contiguous NPU tensor; Kimi supplies `[P,588]` patches | uint8 | ND |
+| `lut` | Input | Contiguous shared-channel table on the same device, `[256]` | BF16 / FP16 | 1D |
+| `vector_cores` | Attribute | Actual Vector core count read during module initialization | host int | scalar |
+| return value | Output | Newly allocated tensor with the input shape and table dtype | BF16 / FP16 | ND |
+
+## Constraints
+
+- Model integration is limited to Kimi-K3/K3.1, patch size 14 and RGB mean/std
+  `[0.5, 0.5, 0.5]`. These conditions are checked once during construction.
+- Legacy `preprocessor_config.json` metadata is also read when processor-class
+  resolution and cached image metadata do not provide `media_proc_cfg`. A
+  `processor_class` field is not required there; missing media settings still
+  raise an error.
+- RGB channels use one table built from the checked processor configuration.
+  The module checks BF16/FP16 support when constructed or moved and retains
+  only 16-bit recovery data outside checkpoint state; its
+  temporary FP32 reference is not stored permanently.
+- Table shape and layout are fixed by module construction. The Vector core
+  count is checked when device properties are read. Runtime checks cover pixel
+  dtype, device and contiguity, matching devices, and the element count.
+- Output dtype must match the actual patch projection dtype. Supported dtype and
+  device moves restore the corresponding table bits instead of converting a
+  previously rounded BF16 table to FP16.
+- Element count must be below `2**31 - 1`. Input and output storage are separate.
+- A2 support, full-model answer accuracy and generation throughput are not
+  established by the single-operator tests.
+
+## JIT warmup
+
+The model constructor registers the module inside the runner's existing model
+load registry window. `KimiPixelNormKernel` derives from
+`AscendTritonJitKernel`; when the shared registry expands its registrations after
+weight loading, it restores the constant table and selects the module's final
+dtype. The three compile keys are `(dtype, BLOCK)`; `count` is a runtime scalar
+with `do_not_specialize`.
+
+`TritonWarmupTensor` supplies aligned pointer metadata, and the existing registry
+compiles the production kernel without launching image payloads. Runtime uses the
+same kernel and launch constructor. With startup warmup enabled, new patch counts
+reuse these variants. Disabling the shared warmup option retains the framework's
+normal lazy compilation behavior.
+
+## Validation
+
+The nightly E2E case is
+`tests/e2e/nightly/single_node/ops/singlecard_ops/triton/test_kimi_pixel_norm.py`.
+It checks both output dtypes, all pixel values against the CPU reference, empty
+inputs, both dispatch boundaries, large inputs, invalid metadata, dtype/device
+lifecycle, changing graph inputs and a shared dynamic Torch compile graph.
+The warmup coverage case uses the real registry, then prohibits further JIT
+compilation while executing multiple patch counts and graph replay. The nightly
+file does not clear or isolate Triton compilation caches, so this case does not
+independently establish cold-cache compilation coverage.
+
+```bash
+pytest -q tests/e2e/nightly/single_node/ops/singlecard_ops/triton/test_kimi_pixel_norm.py
+```
+
+CPU unit tests are in
+`tests/ut/model_executor/warmup/test_jit_warmup_kimi_pixel_norm.py`. They check
+scoped and deduplicated registration, deferred final-dtype key expansion and
+table restoration, metadata-only compilation of all three BLOCK variants, and
+runtime launch coverage at both element-count dispatch boundaries. Compiler and
+device launches are mocked; these tests do not establish NPU output correctness
+or actual cold-cache compilation behavior.
+
+```bash
+pytest -q tests/ut/model_executor/warmup/test_jit_warmup_kimi_pixel_norm.py
+```
+
+Recorded A3 and A5 hardware runs of the FP16-index kernel passed all 10 nightly
+cases on each device. Real-image validation used 1730 MMMU_Pro requests and 2015
+images; all 2,735,879,328 BF16 projection-input elements matched the actual CPU
+processor on each device. These are existing hardware results; the latest
+checkout has not been rerun on NPU.
+
+The C=1 preprocessing comparison includes decoded RGB resize/pad/patchify,
+pinning, H2D and synchronization to BF16 readiness, with one consumer, four Numba
+threads and three alternating CPU/device pairs over the same request order.
+
+| Hardware | CPU requests/s | NPU requests/s | Throughput gain |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| A3 | 148.93 | 171.62 | 15.24% |
+| A5 | 126.83 | 159.65 | 25.87% |
+
+Environment: CANN 9.2.1, torch 2.10.0, torch-npu 2.10.0.post7 and triton-ascend
+3.6.0.post2. These measurements cover image preprocessing, not full-model answer
+accuracy, TTFT or generation throughput. A5 used a shared card, and aggregate
+throughput gains do not establish a latency improvement for every input shape.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM-Ascend project
+"""CPU-reference-exact pixel lookup on A3 and A5 vector cores."""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup import kernel_launcher
+from vllm.model_executor.warmup.jit_warmup_triton_helper import LaunchSpec, TritonWarmupTensor
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import direct_register_custom_op
+
+from vllm_ascend.ops.triton.ascend_jit_warmup import AscendTritonJitKernel
+
+SMALL_ELEMENTS = 196608
+MEDIUM_ELEMENTS = 2408448
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["count"])
+def _kimi_pixel_norm_kernel(
+    pixels,
+    lut,
+    output,
+    count,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    table_offsets = tl.arange(0, 256)
+    table = tl.load(lut + table_offsets)
+    lanes = tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    for tile in range(tl.program_id(0), tl.cdiv(count, BLOCK), tl.num_programs(0)):
+        offsets = tile * BLOCK + lanes
+        valid = offsets < count
+        # Preserve a supported vector Gather index path on the A5 backend.
+        # All uint8 values are represented exactly by FP16 before widening.
+        values = tl.load(pixels + offsets, mask=valid, other=0).to(tl.float16).to(tl.int32)
+        result = tl.gather(table, values, axis=0)
+        tl.store(output + offsets, result, mask=valid)
+
+
+class KimiPixelNormKernel(AscendTritonJitKernel["KimiPixelNormKernel.CompileKey"]):
+    kernel = _kimi_pixel_norm_kernel
+
+    @dataclass(frozen=True)
+    class CompileKey:
+        dtype: torch.dtype
+        block: int
+
+    def get_warmup_keys(self, norm) -> list["KimiPixelNormKernel.CompileKey"]:
+        # Expand after weight loading, using the module's final device/dtype.
+        norm._refresh_table()
+        return [self.CompileKey(norm.lut.dtype, block) for block in (1024, 4096, 8192)]
+
+    def warmup_inputs(self, compile_key: "KimiPixelNormKernel.CompileKey") -> dict:
+        return dict(
+            pixels=TritonWarmupTensor(torch.uint8),
+            lut=TritonWarmupTensor(compile_key.dtype, shape=(256,)),
+            output=TritonWarmupTensor(compile_key.dtype),
+            count=2,
+            BLOCK=compile_key.block,
+            programs=1,
+        )
+
+    @kernel_launcher
+    def __call__(self, pixels, lut, output, count: int, BLOCK: int, programs: int) -> LaunchSpec:
+        return (programs,), {}
+
+
+_KIMI_PIXEL_NORM_KERNEL = KimiPixelNormKernel()
+
+
+def kimi_pixel_norm_lut(pixels: torch.Tensor, lut: torch.Tensor, vector_cores: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if pixels.device.type != "npu" or pixels.dtype != torch.uint8:
+        raise ValueError("kimi_pixel_norm_lut requires uint8 NPU pixels")
+    if not pixels.is_contiguous():
+        raise ValueError("pixels must be contiguous")
+    if lut.device != pixels.device:
+        raise ValueError("lut must be on the pixels device")
+    count = pixels.numel()
+    if count >= 2**31 - 1:
+        raise ValueError("pixel count must be below 2**31 - 1")
+    output = torch.empty_like(pixels, dtype=lut.dtype)
+    if count == 0:
+        return output
+    block = 1024 if count <= SMALL_ELEMENTS else 4096 if count <= MEDIUM_ELEMENTS else 8192
+    programs = min(triton.cdiv(count, block), vector_cores)
+    with torch.npu.device(pixels.device):
+        _KIMI_PIXEL_NORM_KERNEL(pixels=pixels, lut=lut, output=output, count=count, BLOCK=block, programs=programs)
+    return output
+
+
+def _kimi_pixel_norm_lut_fake(pixels: torch.Tensor, lut: torch.Tensor, vector_cores: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return torch.empty_like(pixels, dtype=lut.dtype)
+
+
+direct_register_custom_op(
+    op_name="kimi_pixel_norm_lut",
+    op_func=kimi_pixel_norm_lut,
+    fake_impl=_kimi_pixel_norm_lut_fake,
+    mutates_args=[],
+    dispatch_key="PrivateUse1",
+)

@@ -335,3 +335,158 @@ msgid ""
 msgstr ""
 "有关启动脚本和代理示例，请参见\n"
 "[Atlas 850E 上的 D2RH 部署](../../tutorials/features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md#d2rh-deployment-on-atlas-850e-uboe)。"
+
+msgid "#### Mooncake V2 Layerwise Push Connector"
+msgstr "#### Mooncake V2 逐层推送连接器"
+
+msgid ""
+"Set `kv_connector` to `MooncakePushConnector` on P and D, with `kv_role` set to\n"
+"`kv_producer` and `kv_consumer`, respectively. Use\n"
+"`examples/disaggregated_prefill_v1/load_balance_proxy_layerwise_server_example.py`\n"
+"as the proxy. This experimental path supports PCP/TP routing and PP layer\n"
+"lookup; workers currently require DCP=1 and do not support KVPP."
+msgstr ""
+"在 P 和 D 上将 `kv_connector` 设置为 `MooncakePushConnector`，并将 `kv_role` 分别设置为\n"
+"`kv_producer` 和 `kv_consumer`。使用\n"
+"`examples/disaggregated_prefill_v1/load_balance_proxy_layerwise_server_example.py`\n"
+"作为代理。此实验性路径支持 PCP/TP 路由和 PP 层\n"
+"查找；worker 目前要求 DCP=1，且不支持 KVPP。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The proxy sends the request to D first. After allocating blocks, D's scheduler\n"
+"submits an immutable destination snapshot to a 32-worker HTTP thread pool,\n"
+"which posts to the proxy's `/v1/metaserver`. The scheduler continues scheduling\n"
+"without waiting for HTTP. The proxy forwards the destination parameters to P;\n"
+"no Mooncake bootstrap server or worker Ready handshake is used."
+msgstr ""
+"代理首先将请求发送给 D。分配块后，D 的调度器\n"
+"将不可变的目标快照提交到包含 32 个 worker 的 HTTP 线程池，\n"
+"该线程池向代理的 `/v1/metaserver` 发送请求。调度器继续调度，\n"
+"而不等待 HTTP。代理将目标参数转发给 P；\n"
+"不使用 Mooncake bootstrap 服务器或 worker Ready 握手。"
+
+msgid ""
+"While P has outstanding transfers, its scheduler sets `has_sync_kv_loads=True`\n"
+"so that `start_load_kv()` prepares request state before forward and layer hooks.\n"
+"P queries D's scheduler metadata service for cache layouts. Its transfer\n"
+"pool writes each layer and sends completion to D workers. D waits for all P\n"
+"ranks, including ranks with no data to send, before reporting receive completion.\n"
+"Completions that arrive before D's worker allocation metadata are buffered.\n"
+"P waits for this step's metadata queries, WRITEs and terminal DONE callbacks\n"
+"before returning worker results. Normal prefill completion releases KV without\n"
+"delay-free; asynchronous scheduling remains enabled. This path currently assumes\n"
+"successful transfer; request-level transfer failure reporting is TODO. Early\n"
+"cancellation still retains the existing delayed-release protection."
+msgstr ""
+"当 P 存在未完成的传输时，其调度器会设置 `has_sync_kv_loads=True`，\n"
+"以便 `start_load_kv()` 在前向计算和层钩子之前准备请求状态。\n"
+"P 向 D 的调度器元数据服务查询缓存布局。其传输\n"
+"池写入每一层，并向 D worker 发送完成通知。D 等待所有 P\n"
+"rank（包括没有数据要发送的 rank）完成后才报告接收完成。\n"
+"在 D 的 worker 分配元数据之前到达的完成通知会被缓冲。\n"
+"P 在返回 worker 结果之前，会等待本步骤的元数据查询、WRITE 和最终 DONE 回调。\n"
+"正常 prefill 完成会立即释放 KV，而不使用 delay-free；异步调度仍然启用。此路径目前假定\n"
+"传输成功；请求级传输失败上报尚待实现（TODO）。提前\n"
+"取消仍保留现有的延迟释放保护。"
+
+msgid "P follows this lifecycle:"
+msgstr "P 遵循以下生命周期："
+
+msgid ""
+"1. `update_state_after_alloc()` records source blocks. `build_connector_meta()`\n"
+"   appends new chunk blocks and snapshots the scheduled prompt token range.\n"
+"2. `start_load_kv()` installs the chunk metadata and starts or reuses the D\n"
+"   metadata query. Destination topology is checked once per request after the\n"
+"   query completes. The previous step's sends have already been drained.\n"
+"3. `save_kv_layer()` records a device event for the layer's caches and submits\n"
+"   available ranges to the transfer pool. SWA, circular and Mamba caches wait\n"
+"   for the final chunk; non-owner ranks send DONE without a WRITE.\n"
+"4. The runner calls `wait_for_save()` to publish remaining cache ranges and\n"
+"   drain this step's transfers. With speculative decoding, this happens during\n"
+"   finalization after draft execution. `get_transfer_results()` polls results\n"
+"   without invoking this barrier or marking unfinished caches ready.\n"
+"5. `request_finished()` releases normally completed requests immediately and\n"
+"   sends a worker bookkeeping cleanup notice on the next step. Published\n"
+"   requests cancelled before completion keep their blocks until workers report\n"
+"   `finished_sending`; only those cancellations are forwarded to core for\n"
+"   delayed release. P preemption remains unsupported and is a TODO."
+msgstr ""
+"1. `update_state_after_alloc()` 记录源块。`build_connector_meta()`\n"
+"   追加新的 chunk 块，并对已调度的 prompt token 范围进行快照。\n"
+"2. `start_load_kv()` 安装 chunk 元数据，并启动或复用 D\n"
+"   元数据查询。查询完成后，每个请求会检查一次目标拓扑。\n"
+"   上一步的发送已经排空。\n"
+"3. `save_kv_layer()` 为该层的缓存记录一个设备事件，并将\n"
+"   可用范围提交到传输池。SWA、circular 和 Mamba 缓存等待\n"
+"   最后一个 chunk；非 owner rank 发送 DONE 而不发送 WRITE。\n"
+"4. runner 调用 `wait_for_save()` 发布剩余的缓存范围，并\n"
+"   排空本步骤的传输。在使用投机解码时，这发生在\n"
+"   draft 执行之后的收尾阶段。`get_transfer_results()` 轮询结果，\n"
+"   而不触发此屏障或将未完成的缓存标记为就绪。\n"
+"5. `request_finished()` 立即释放正常完成的请求，并在下一步\n"
+"   发送 worker 簿记清理通知。已发布但在完成前被取消的\n"
+"   请求会保留其块，直到 worker 报告\n"
+"   `finished_sending`；只有这些取消会被转发到 core 以进行\n"
+"   延迟释放。P 抢占仍不受支持，属于 TODO。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Layer cache grouping uses the name prefix before the first numeric component\n"
+"and the extracted layer index. For example, `model.layers.0.attn` and\n"
+"`mtp.layer.0.self_attn` belong to separate namespaces even though both have index\n"
+"zero. Names must still contain the numeric layer index expected by\n"
+"`extract_layer_index()`. With multiple namespaces, layer hooks publish only\n"
+"their own group's caches; final flushing and DONE submission happen in\n"
+"`wait_for_save()` after draft execution rather than at the largest layer index."
+msgstr ""
+"层缓存分组使用第一个数字组件之前的名称前缀\n"
+"以及提取出的层索引。例如，`model.layers.0.attn` 和\n"
+"`mtp.layer.0.self_attn` 属于不同的命名空间，尽管两者的索引\n"
+"都为零。名称仍必须包含 `extract_layer_index()` 所期望的\n"
+"数字层索引。存在多个命名空间时，层钩子只发布\n"
+"其自身组的缓存；最终刷新和 DONE 提交发生在 draft 执行之后的\n"
+"`wait_for_save()` 中，而不是在最大层索引处。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The existing metaserver responds after P finishes. Consequently, outstanding\n"
+"HTTP requests occupy pool threads for that duration. A multi-prompt request\n"
+"must fit within both D's concurrent allocation capacity and the HTTP pool;\n"
+"otherwise waiting sibling notifications can exhaust the pool. Connection\n"
+"establishment failures are retried up to three attempts; response failures are\n"
+"not replayed because P may already have been dispatched. Background HTTP\n"
+"failures are collected in a later scheduling step and sent to D workers. A\n"
+"connection-establishment failure finishes that receive as failed. Invalid\n"
+"metaserver URLs and rejected pool submissions also fail new receives before\n"
+"publishing their addresses. When P may\n"
+"already have been dispatched, D marks the receive failed but retains its blocks\n"
+"until all P ranks report drained writes. Late HTTP errors do not reopen completed\n"
+"receives. Each request is assumed to use one P engine with a fixed topology.\n"
+"On D, missing terminal completions and unconfirmed WRITE drain mark only the\n"
+"affected receive as failed; they do not stop the worker. Failure is reported together with receive completion\n"
+"once all source WRITEs are confirmed drained. Until then, the request and its\n"
+"blocks remain pending (client cancellation can end the request but does not\n"
+"release its blocks). A late drained DONE can complete the receive.\n"
+"Cancellation/drain recovery for a permanently lost P is not yet\n"
+"implemented, so repeated failures can exhaust D's available KV blocks. A failure\n"
+"of the shared DONE listener remains fatal."
+msgstr ""
+"现有的 metaserver 在 P 完成后才响应。因此，未完成的\n"
+"HTTP 请求会在该时间段内占用池线程。多 prompt 请求\n"
+"必须同时满足 D 的并发分配容量和 HTTP 池的限制；\n"
+"否则等待中的同级通知可能耗尽池。连接\n"
+"建立失败最多重试三次；响应失败不会\n"
+"重放，因为 P 可能已经被调度。后台 HTTP\n"
+"失败会在后续调度步骤中收集并发送给 D worker。连接\n"
+"建立失败会将该接收标记为失败。无效的\n"
+"metaserver URL 和被拒绝的池提交也会在发布其地址之前\n"
+"使新的接收失败。当 P 可能\n"
+"已经被调度时，D 会将接收标记为失败，但保留其块，\n"
+"直到所有 P rank 报告写入已排空。迟到的 HTTP 错误不会重新打开已完成的\n"
+"接收。假定每个请求使用一个具有固定拓扑的 P 引擎。\n"
+"在 D 上，缺少最终完成通知和未确认的 WRITE 排空只会将\n"
+"受影响的接收标记为失败；它们不会停止 worker。一旦所有源 WRITE 确认排空，\n"
+"失败会与接收完成一起上报。在此之前，请求及其\n"
+"块保持挂起状态（客户端取消可以结束请求，但不会\n"
+"释放其块）。迟到的已排空 DONE 可以完成该接收。\n"
+"针对永久丢失的 P 的取消/排空恢复尚未\n"
+"实现，因此重复失败可能耗尽 D 的可用 KV 块。共享 DONE 监听器\n"
+"的失败仍然是致命的。"

+"   kernel 所使用的确切存储。\n"

+"8. 禁用 EPLB 的执行与 EPLB 路径保持隔离。\n"
+"9. routing 热路径避免主机循环、设备到主机同步以及\n"
+"   可变的 Python 映射操作。"

-msgid ""

-msgid ""
-"Use the body of the block to add shell wrapper lines such as `set -eux`. Always\n"
-"place the `{{ generated }}` placeholder where the converter output should be\n"
-"inserted."
-msgstr ""

-msgstr "#### converter_tag: `single_node`"
-
-msgid ""
-"`single_node` reads one item from `test_cases`. The optional `case_index`\n"
-"metadata selects the item; when omitted, it defaults to `0`."
-msgstr ""
-"`single_node` 从 `test_cases` 中读取一个条目。可选的 `case_index` 元数据用于选择条目；省略时默认为 `0`。"

-msgid ""
-"Only the fields read by this converter are expanded below. Other test metadata\n"
-"can be left in the YAML and is ignored by this converter."
-msgstr "仅此转换器读取的字段会在下面展开。其他测试元数据可以保留在 YAML 中，此转换器会忽略它们。"

-msgid ""
-"`envs` is rendered as `export` lines. `SERVER_PORT: DEFAULT_PORT` is resolved\n"
-"to the default single-node port `8000`. `model` becomes `vllm serve <model>`,\n"
-"and `server_cmd` plus optional `server_cmd_extra` become command arguments.\n"
-"Both command fields can be either a shell string or a flat token list."

-"`8000`。`model` 变为 `vllm serve <model>`，`server_cmd` 加上可选的 `server_cmd_extra`"
-" 变为命令参数。两个命令字段都可以是 shell 字符串或扁平令牌列表。"

-msgid "### For developers: add a new converter"
-msgstr "### 面向开发者：添加新的转换器"
-
-msgid ""
-"A converter turns one loaded YAML file plus one parsed `ModelCodeBlock` into a\n"
-"`GeneratedScript`. The current pipeline is:"
-msgstr ""
-"转换器将一个已加载的 YAML 文件和一个解析后的 `ModelCodeBlock` 转换为\n"
-"`GeneratedScript`。当前的流程如下："
-
-msgid ""
-"1. `BlockScanner` parses ``model-code`` fences and accepts only options listed\n"
-"   in `MODEL_CODE_OPTION_NAMES`.\n"
-"2. `YamlLoader` loads `test_case_path`.\n"
-"3. `get_converter()` looks up `block.converter_tag` from\n"
-"   `build_default_converters()`.\n"
-"4. The selected converter returns `GeneratedScript(content=..., language=\"shell\")`.\n"
-"5. `GeneratorService` replaces `{{ generated }}` in the block body, validates\n"
-"   that the final script is non-empty, and writes\n"
-"   `docs/_build/doc_codegen/<doc_stem>/<block_name>.sh`."
-msgstr ""
-"1. `BlockScanner` 解析 ``model-code`` 围栏，仅接受 `MODEL_CODE_OPTION_NAMES` 中列出的选项。\n"
-"2. `YamlLoader` 加载 `test_case_path`。\n"
-"3. `get_converter()` 从 `build_default_converters()` 中查找 `block.converter_tag`。\n"
-"4. 选定的转换器返回 `GeneratedScript(content=..., language=\"shell\")`。\n"
-"5. `GeneratorService` 替换块体中的 `{{ generated }}`，验证最终脚本非空，并写入\n"
-"   `docs/_build/doc_codegen/<doc_stem>/<block_name>.sh`。"
-
-msgid "To add a converter:"
-msgstr "要添加转换器，请执行以下步骤："
-
-msgid ""
-"1. In `tools/docs_codegen/converters.py`, add a `BaseConverter` subclass with a\n"
-"   unique `name`. That name is the value authors put in `:converter_tag:`.\n"
-"2. Implement `convert(self, loaded_yaml, *, block) -> GeneratedScript`. Use\n"
-"   `make_docs_codegen_error(..., block=block)` for user-facing validation\n"
-"   errors so the CLI and Sphinx output include document context.\n"
-"3. Reuse helpers from `tools/docs_codegen/utils.py`, such as\n"
-"   `require_mapping`, `require_mapping_list`, `require_scalar_mapping`,\n"
-"   `require_indexed_mapping`, `require_node_field`, `parse_command_tokens`,\n"
-"   `substitute_template_positionals`, and `render_cli_command`.\n"
-"4. Register the converter in `build_default_converters()`. If it is not\n"
-"   registered, `get_converter()` will reject the new `converter_tag`.\n"
-"5. If the converter needs new directive metadata, add the option name to\n"
-"   `MODEL_CODE_OPTION_NAMES` in `tools/docs_codegen/scanner.py` and to\n"
-"   `ModelCodeDirective.option_spec` in\n"
-"   `tools/docs_codegen/sphinx_extension.py`. Read the option with\n"
-"   `block.get_option(\"<option_name>\")`.\n"
-"6. Add or update tests in `tests/ut/tools/test_docs_codegen.py`. Cover the\n"
-"   successful render path, required option validation, YAML shape validation,\n"
-"   and any CLI/Sphinx scanner behavior affected by new metadata.\n"
-"7. Add a real ``model-code`` example in a model tutorial, preferably under\n"

@@ -972,3 +972,115 @@ msgstr ""
 "如有需要，可直接调整 `--gpu-memory-utilization`。\n"
 "降低它会减少可用的 KV 容量，并可能减少 D 的暂存分配；\n"
 "更改后请重新检查主机内存和最大请求容量。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The fixed timeout below applies to `MooncakeConnectorV1`. For\n"
+"    `MooncakeConnectorV2`, use the renewable KV leases described below."
+msgstr ""
+"以下固定超时适用于 `MooncakeConnectorV1`。对于\n"
+"    `MooncakeConnectorV2`，请使用下文描述的可续期 KV 租约。"
+
+msgid "### MooncakeConnectorV2 KV Leases"
+msgstr "### MooncakeConnectorV2 KV 租约"
+
+msgid ""
+"`MooncakeConnectorV2` retains producer KV\n"
+"blocks with an initial 120-second lease. While a request is waiting on D or its\n"
+"KV transfer is in progress, a\n"
+"dedicated connector thread sends batched heartbeats every 20 seconds. Each\n"
+"heartbeat extends the deadline to the later of the existing deadline and\n"
+"80 seconds after receipt on P. Heartbeats do not depend on scheduler steps or\n"
+"model forward completion. P releases the blocks after aggregated transfer\n"
+"completion, or when the lease expires without renewal."
+msgstr ""
+"`MooncakeConnectorV2` 以初始 120 秒的租约保留生产者侧的 KV\n"
+"块。当请求在 D 上等待或其\n"
+"KV 传输正在进行时，一个\n"
+"专用的 connector 线程每 20 秒发送批量心跳。每次\n"
+"心跳都会将截止时间延长至现有截止时间与\n"
+"P 收到后 80 秒两者中的较晚者。心跳不依赖调度器步进或\n"
+"模型前向完成。P 在聚合传输\n"
+"完成后释放这些块，或在租约到期且未续期时释放。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Registration starts when the scheduler calls `on_new_request()`, before KV\n"
+"allocation. Once registered, requests keep renewing while waiting for scheduling\n"
+"or model execution. Requests still waiting in EngineCore's input queue before\n"
+"scheduler admission are not tracked and remain subject to the initial P lease."
+msgstr ""
+"注册在调度器调用 `on_new_request()` 时开始，此时尚未进行 KV\n"
+"分配。注册后，请求在等待调度\n"
+"或模型执行期间会持续续期。仍在 EngineCore 输入队列中等待\n"
+"调度器准入的请求不会被跟踪，并仍受初始 P 租约约束。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Set `kv_lease_duration` to the same integer value on P and D (at least 6 seconds).\n"
+"P includes its configured duration as `remote_kv_lease_duration` in the returned\n"
+"`kv_transfer_params`. On the first request with remote KV from each P, D\n"
+"validates this value before registering heartbeats or starting a KV read and\n"
+"caches the successful result for **600 seconds (10 minutes)** using a monotonic\n"
+"clock, with a limit of **1024 P endpoints** per D scheduler. Cache hits do not\n"
+"extend this lifetime. Expired results are not reused; entries are reclaimed\n"
+"lazily on cache writes or shutdown, without a background cleanup thread. At\n"
+"capacity, the least recently used entry is evicted. An expired or evicted\n"
+"endpoint is validated again on its next request. These are internal cache\n"
+"constants, independent of the KV lease duration and heartbeat interval.\n"
+"Within this lifetime, subsequent requests reuse the result while P's\n"
+"endpoint, engine ID, and advertised duration remain unchanged. A new P instance\n"
+"or a changed duration triggers validation again, including when a restarted P\n"
+"reuses an explicitly configured engine ID. A missing, invalid, or different\n"
+"duration raises a configuration error and is not cached. Validation happens on\n"
+"request admission, not at service startup. The error propagates to\n"
+"EngineCore and can terminate D; correct the configuration and restart D before\n"
+"retrying. Proxies must preserve this field when forwarding `kv_transfer_params`;\n"
+"upgrade P before D.\n"
+"The heartbeat interval is `duration // 6` and the renewal window is\n"
+"`duration * 2 // 3`. For example, add this configuration\n"
+"to each side's existing `--kv-transfer-config`:"
+msgstr ""
+"在 P 和 D 上将 `kv_lease_duration` 设置为相同的整数值（至少 6 秒）。\n"
+"P 会将其配置的时长作为 `remote_kv_lease_duration` 包含在返回的\n"
+"`kv_transfer_params` 中。对于来自每个 P 的首次携带远程 KV 的请求，D\n"
+"会在注册心跳或开始 KV 读取之前校验该值，并使用单调\n"
+"时钟将成功结果缓存 **600 秒（10 分钟）**，每个 D 调度器的上限为 **1024 个 P 端点**。缓存命中不会\n"
+"延长该生命周期。过期结果不会被复用；条目会在缓存写入或关闭时\n"
+"惰性回收，没有后台清理线程。达到\n"
+"容量时，将驱逐最近最少使用的条目。过期或被驱逐的\n"
+"端点会在其下一次请求时重新校验。这些是内部缓存\n"
+"常量，与 KV 租约时长和心跳间隔无关。\n"
+"在该生命周期内，只要 P 的\n"
+"端点、引擎 ID 和通告时长保持不变，后续请求就会复用该结果。新的 P 实例\n"
+"或时长变化会再次触发校验，包括重启后的 P\n"
+"复用显式配置的引擎 ID 的情况。时长缺失、无效或不同\n"
+"会引发配置错误且不会被缓存。校验发生在\n"
+"请求准入时，而非服务启动时。该错误会传播到\n"
+"EngineCore，并可能导致 D 终止；请修正配置并重启 D 后再\n"
+"重试。代理在转发 `kv_transfer_params` 时必须保留此字段；\n"
+"请先升级 P 再升级 D。\n"
+"心跳间隔为 `duration // 6`，续期窗口为\n"
+"`duration * 2 // 3`。例如，将以下配置\n"
+"添加到每一侧现有的 `--kv-transfer-config` 中："
+
+msgid ""
+"Heartbeats are always enabled for `MooncakeConnectorV2`. `kv_lease_duration`\n"
+"(default 120 seconds) replaces `VLLM_MOONCAKE_ABORT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` for V2;\n"
+"there is no heartbeat switch or fallback to the former 480-second timeout.\n"
+"Configure the same duration on P and D, and upgrade P before D.\n"
+"MooncakeConnectorV1 keeps its existing timeout behavior."
+msgstr ""
+"`MooncakeConnectorV2` 始终启用心跳。`kv_lease_duration`\n"
+"（默认 120 秒）在 V2 中取代 `VLLM_MOONCAKE_ABORT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT`；\n"
+"没有心跳开关，也不会回退到原先的 480 秒超时。\n"
+"请在 P 和 D 上配置相同的时长，并先升级 P 再升级 D。\n"
+"MooncakeConnectorV1 保持其现有的超时行为。"
+
+msgid ""
+"An aborted request with an in-flight read keeps its lease until worker\n"
+"completion is reported. If the entire D process stops running or the control\n"
+"network is disconnected, heartbeats stop and the lease expires. Heartbeats\n"
+"do not replace transport completion or cancellation synchronization."
+msgstr ""
+"带有进行中读取的已中止请求会保留其租约，直到报告 worker\n"

 msgid "#### 5.2.2.5 Key Parameter Descriptions"
 msgstr "#### 5.2.2.5 关键参数说明"
 
-msgid ""
-"- The A2 layout is 1P1D: the Prefill role spans two servers (DP4/TP4\n"
-"      ranks each) and the Decode role spans two servers (DP8/TP2 ranks\n"
-"      each). On every A2 server the local DP ranks multiplied by TP must\n"
-"      consume all 8 devices: 2 × 4 on each Prefill server and 4 × 2 on each\n"
-"      Decode server.\n"
-"    - `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=360000` gives every Prefill and Decode\n"
-"      engine up to 100 hours to finish startup. Weights are loaded from shared\n"
-"      storage, which is slower on A2; this validated value is intentionally\n"
-"      larger than the A3 value.\n"
-"    - Both roles use `--engram-config '{\"cpu_offload\":true,\"dp_shared_memory\":true}'`.\n"
-"      The Engram table is kept in host memory and shared by the local DP\n"
-"      ranks of each server. With TP4 and TP2 the model's 24 Engram heads are\n"
-"      divided evenly (6 and 12 heads per rank), but the host-memory table must\n"
-"      still be shared across the node's local DP ranks, which requires the\n"
-"      container to run with `--ipc=host` or a `/dev/shm` of at least 320g.\n"
-"    - Prefix caching is enabled only on Prefill. Decode disables it and\n"
-"      enables `recompute_scheduler_enable` so requests can be recomputed when\n"
-"      the Prefill-side KV cache is unavailable.\n"
-"    - Prefill and Decode use the same --additional-config options as A3.\n"
-"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` and the socket interface variables must select the same\n"
-"      high-speed service network used by the configured node IPs.\n"
-"      `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1` enables RoCE transport for intra-node HCCL\n"
-"      on A2. `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` is `1024` on Prefill and `1800` on Decode;\n"
-"      retain these role-specific values unless another setting has been\n"
-"      validated. `HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=\"AIV\"` is set on Prefill only.\n"
-"    Wait until every engine finishes loading weights and Decode finishes graph\n"
-"    capture. A successful startup includes output similar to:"
-msgstr ""
-"- A2 布局为 1P1D：Prefill 角色跨两台服务器（每台为 DP4/TP4\n"
-"      rank），Decode 角色跨两台服务器（每台为 DP8/TP2\n"
-"      rank）。在每台 A2 服务器上，本地 DP rank 乘以 TP 必须\n"
-"      占满全部 8 个设备：每台 Prefill 服务器为 2 × 4，每台\n"
-"      Decode 服务器为 4 × 2。\n"
-"    - `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=360000` 为每个 Prefill 和 Decode\n"
-"      引擎提供最多 100 小时来完成启动。权重从共享\n"
-"      存储加载，在 A2 上较慢；此经过验证的值有意\n"
-"      大于 A3 的值。\n"
-"    - 两个角色都使用 `--engram-config '{\"cpu_offload\":true,\"dp_shared_memory\":true}'`。\n"
-"      Engram 表保存在主机内存中，由每台服务器的本地 DP\n"
-"      rank 共享。在 TP4 和 TP2 下，模型的 24 个 Engram head 被\n"
-"      均匀划分（每个 rank 分别为 6 和 12 个 head），但主机内存表\n"
-"      仍必须在该节点的本地 DP rank 之间共享，这要求\n"
-"      容器以 `--ipc=host` 运行，或 `/dev/shm` 至少为 320g。\n"
-"    - 前缀缓存仅在 Prefill 上启用。Decode 禁用它并\n"
-"      启用 `recompute_scheduler_enable`，以便在\n"
-"      Prefill 侧 KV cache 不可用时重新计算请求。\n"
-"    - Prefill 和 Decode 使用与 A3 相同的 --additional-config 选项。\n"
-"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` 和 socket 接口变量必须选择与\n"
-"      所配置节点 IP 相同的高速服务网络。\n"
-"      `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1` 在 A2 上为节点内 HCCL 启用 RoCE\n"
-"      传输。`HCCL_BUFFSIZE` 在 Prefill 上为 `1024`，在 Decode 上为 `1800`；\n"
-"      除非已验证其他设置，否则保留这些角色特定的值。\n"
-"      `HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=\"AIV\"` 仅在 Prefill 上设置。\n"
-"    等待每个引擎完成权重加载且 Decode 完成图\n"
-"    捕获。成功启动包含类似以下的输出："

+msgid "An A2 server exposes 8 devices. Run this command on both A2 servers."

+msgid ""
+"This example uses two Atlas 800 A2 servers: one Prefill server and one\n"
+"    Decode server. The Prefill role runs two DP ranks with TP1 and PCP4\n"

+"    role runs eight DP ranks with TP1 (DP8/TP1), so each DP rank uses one\n"
+"    logical device. Both layouts consume all 8 logical devices on their\n"
+"    server. Mooncake transfers KV cache from the Prefill engines to the\n"
+"    Decode engines."
+msgstr ""
+"本示例使用两台 Atlas 800 A2 服务器：一台 Prefill 服务器和一台\n"
+"    Decode 服务器。Prefill 角色运行两个 DP rank，使用 TP1 和 PCP4\n"
+"    （DP2/TP1/PCP4），因此每个 DP rank 使用四个逻辑设备。Decode\n"
+"    角色运行八个 DP rank，使用 TP1（DP8/TP1），因此每个 DP rank 使用一个\n"
+"    逻辑设备。两种布局都会用满各自服务器上的全部 8 个逻辑设备。Mooncake 负责将 KV cache 从 Prefill 引擎传输到\n"
+"    Decode 引擎。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Save the DP launcher from\n"

+"    on both nodes. It divides the node's visible devices among local DP ranks,\n"
+"    allocates `tp-size * pcp-size` devices to each rank, and starts one vLLM\n"
+"    process per rank."
+msgstr ""
+"将\n"
+"    [5.2.1.1 节](#5211-prepare-the-dp-launcher)中的 DP 启动器保存为 `launch_online_dp.py`，\n"
+"    放在两个节点上。它会将节点上可见的设备分配给本地 DP rank，\n"
+"    为每个 rank 分配 `tp-size * pcp-size` 个设备，并为每个 rank 启动一个 vLLM\n"
+"    进程。"
+
+msgid ""
+"    | `--dp-rank-start` | First DP rank assigned to this node. It is `0` for"
+" both node groups in this 1P1D example. |"

+"    | `--dp-rank-start` | 分配给此节点的第一个 DP rank。在此 1P1D 示例中，两个节点组均为 `0`。 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"The launcher passes eight positional arguments to `run_dp_template.sh`:\n"
+"    `visible_devices`, `vllm_engine_port`, `dp_size`, `dp_rank`,\n"
+"    `dp_address`, `dp_rpc_port`, `tp_size`, and `pcp_size`."
+msgstr ""
+"启动器会向 `run_dp_template.sh` 传递八个位置参数：\n"
+"    `visible_devices`、`vllm_engine_port`、`dp_size`、`dp_rank`、\n"
+"    `dp_address`、`dp_rpc_port`、`tp_size` 和 `pcp_size`。"
+
+msgid "#### 5.2.2.2 Start the Prefill Node"
+msgstr "#### 5.2.2.2 启动 Prefill 节点"
+
+msgid ""
+"On the Prefill node, save the following script as `run_dp_template.sh`.\n"
+"    Set `LOCAL_IP`, `NIC_NAME`, and `MODEL_PATH` to the Prefill node's service\n"

+"在 Prefill 节点上，将以下脚本保存为 `run_dp_template.sh`。\n"
+"    将 `LOCAL_IP`、`NIC_NAME` 和 `MODEL_PATH` 设置为 Prefill 节点的服务\n"

+msgid "Start two DP2/TP1/PCP4 Prefill engines on the Prefill node:"
+msgstr "在 Prefill 节点上启动两个 DP2/TP1/PCP4 Prefill 引擎："
+
+msgid "#### 5.2.2.3 Start the Decode Node"
+msgstr "#### 5.2.2.3 启动 Decode 节点"
+
+msgid ""
+"On the Decode node, save the following script as `run_dp_template.sh`.\n"
+"    Set `LOCAL_IP`, `NIC_NAME`, and `MODEL_PATH` to the Decode node's service\n"
+"    IP, network interface, and the same checkpoint path used on the Prefill\n"
+"    node."
+msgstr ""
+"在 Decode 节点上，将以下脚本保存为 `run_dp_template.sh`。\n"
+"    将 `LOCAL_IP`、`NIC_NAME` 和 `MODEL_PATH` 设置为 Decode 节点的服务\n"
+"    IP、网络接口，以及与 Prefill\n"
+"    节点相同的 checkpoint 路径。"
+
+msgid "Start eight DP8/TP1 Decode engines on the Decode node:"
+msgstr "在 Decode 节点上启动八个 DP8/TP1 Decode 引擎："
+
+msgid ""
+"After all ten engines are ready (two Prefill and eight Decode), deploy\n"
+"    the proxy as described in\n"
+"    [Prefill-Decode Disaggregation (DeepSeek)](../features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md).\n"
+"    Configure the proxy with Prefill endpoints `<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:7100` and\n"
+"    `<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:7101`, and Decode endpoints `<DECODE_NODE_IP>:7100`\n"
+"    through `<DECODE_NODE_IP>:7107`. For example, run the load-balancing\n"
+"    proxy on the Prefill node:"
+msgstr ""
+"待全部十个引擎就绪（两个 Prefill 和八个 Decode）后，按照\n"
+"    [Prefill-Decode 分离部署（DeepSeek）](../features/pd_disaggregation_mooncake_multi_node.md)中的说明部署\n"
+"    代理。\n"
+"    将代理的 Prefill 端点配置为 `<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:7100` 和\n"
+"    `<PREFILL_NODE_IP>:7101`，Decode 端点配置为 `<DECODE_NODE_IP>:7100`\n"
+"    至 `<DECODE_NODE_IP>:7107`。例如，在 Prefill 节点上运行负载均衡\n"
+"    代理："
+
+msgid ""
+"- The A2 layout is 1P1D on two servers: the Prefill server runs\n"
+"      DP2/TP1/PCP4 and the Decode server runs DP8/TP1. On each server,\n"
+"      local DP ranks multiplied by `tp_size * pcp_size` consume all 8\n"
+"      devices: 2 × 4 on Prefill and 8 × 1 on Decode.\n"
+"    - `--max-num-batched-tokens` is a per-DP-rank budget, not a per-node\n"
+"      budget. Because PCP4 leaves only two Prefill ranks, `4096` keeps the\n"
+"      node-level chunk size comparable to a four-rank layout. `4096` is also\n"
+"      the largest value that preserves the 1M-token context: it leaves about\n"
+"      6.0 GiB of KV cache per device, while a 1M-token request needs about\n"
+"      4.9 GiB. Lowering the value to `2048` roughly halves Prefill\n"
+"      throughput, and `8192` leaves too little KV cache for the 1M context.\n"
+"    - `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=36000` gives every Prefill and Decode\n"
+"      engine up to 36,000 seconds to finish startup, including weight loading\n"
+"      and graph preparation.\n"
+"    - `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` selects model runner V2 on both roles.\n"
+"    - Both roles use `--engram-config '{\"cpu_offload\":true,\"dp_shared_memory\":true}'`.\n"
+"      The Engram table is kept in host memory and shared by the local DP\n"
+"      ranks of each server. With TP1, the model's 24 Engram heads are split\n"
+"      across the DP ranks (12 heads per Prefill rank and 3 heads per Decode\n"
+"      rank), and the host-memory table must still be shared across the node's\n"
+"      local DP ranks. That requires the container to run with `--ipc=host`\n"
+"      or a `/dev/shm` of at least 320g.\n"
+"    - The Decode role uses `--kv-cache-memory-bytes 4600000000` (about\n"
+"      4.28 GiB) to fix the KV cache budget. On A2 with DP8/TP1 a device\n"
+"      holds about 53.6 GiB of weights, so at `0.97` utilization the KV cache\n"
+"      would otherwise consume nearly all remaining HBM and leave no room for\n"
+"      the eager dummy batch that idle DP ranks run while other ranks execute.\n"
+"      A 1M-token request needs about 4.18 GiB of KV cache per device, so the\n"
+"      fixed budget keeps 1M support with about 2% headroom. When this option\n"
+"      is set, vLLM skips KV memory profiling and\n"
+"      `--gpu-memory-utilization` no longer determines the KV cache size; it\n"
+"      still applies to the other memory budgeting logic.\n"
+"    - Prefix caching is enabled only on Prefill. Decode disables it and\n"
+"      enables `recompute_scheduler_enable` so requests can be recomputed when\n"
+"      the Prefill-side KV cache is unavailable.\n"
+"    - Prefill uses `--enforce-eager` with `--swa-bounded-replay`. Decode uses\n"
+"      `--async-scheduling`, captures the Decode path with `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`,\n"
+"      and sets `--no-swa-bounded-replay` because its\n"
+"      `recompute_scheduler_enable` path cannot perform bounded replay.\n"
+"    - Both roles set `enable_flashcomm1` to `false`; on Prefill this is required\n"
+"      for compatibility with SWA bounded replay. Prefill enables\n"
+"      `enable_fused_mc2` and `enable_shared_expert_dp`; Decode enables\n"
+"      `multistream_overlap_shared_expert` instead.\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` and the socket interface variables must select the same\n"
+"      high-speed service network used by the configured node IPs.\n"
+"      `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1` enables RoCE transport for intra-node HCCL\n"
+"      on A2. `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` is `1024` on Prefill and `1800` on Decode;\n"
+"      retain these role-specific values unless another setting has been\n"
+"      validated. `HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=\"AIV\"` is set on Prefill only.\n"
+"    Wait until every engine finishes loading weights and Decode finishes graph\n"
+"    capture. A successful startup includes output similar to:"
+msgstr ""
+"- A2 布局为两台服务器上的 1P1D：Prefill 服务器运行\n"
+"      DP2/TP1/PCP4，Decode 服务器运行 DP8/TP1。在每台服务器上，\n"
+"      本地 DP rank 数乘以 `tp_size * pcp_size` 会占用全部 8 个\n"
+"      设备：Prefill 上为 2 × 4，Decode 上为 8 × 1。\n"
+"    - `--max-num-batched-tokens` 是每个 DP rank 的预算，而不是每个节点的\n"
+"      预算。由于 PCP4 只留下两个 Prefill rank，`4096` 可使\n"
+"      节点级 chunk 大小与四 rank 布局相当。`4096` 也是\n"
+"      能保留 1M token 上下文的最大值：它可为每个设备留下约\n"
+"      6.0 GiB 的 KV cache，而 1M token 请求需要约\n"
+"      4.9 GiB。将该值降低到 `2048` 会使 Prefill\n"
+"      吞吐量大约减半，而 `8192` 会为 1M 上下文留下过少的 KV cache。\n"
+"    - `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=36000` 为每个 Prefill 和 Decode\n"
+"      引擎提供最多 36,000 秒来完成启动，包括权重加载\n"
+"      和图准备。\n"
+"    - `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` 在两个角色上都选择 model runner V2。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都使用 `--engram-config '{\"cpu_offload\":true,\"dp_shared_memory\":true}'`。\n"
+"      Engram 表保存在主机内存中，并由每台服务器的本地 DP\n"
+"      rank 共享。在 TP1 下，模型的 24 个 Engram head 会\n"
+"      拆分到各个 DP rank 上（每个 Prefill rank 12 个 head，每个 Decode\n"
+"      rank 3 个 head），并且主机内存表仍必须在该节点的\n"
+"      本地 DP rank 之间共享。这要求容器以 `--ipc=host`\n"
+"      运行，或使用至少 320g 的 `/dev/shm`。\n"
+"    - Decode 角色使用 `--kv-cache-memory-bytes 4600000000`（约\n"
+"      4.28 GiB）来固定 KV cache 预算。在 A2 上使用 DP8/TP1 时，一个设备\n"
+"      持有约 53.6 GiB 的权重，因此在 `0.97` 利用率下，KV cache\n"
+"      否则会占用几乎所有剩余的 HBM，导致空闲 DP rank 在其他 rank 执行时\n"
+"      运行的 eager dummy batch 没有空间。\n"
+"      一个 1M token 请求需要每个设备约 4.18 GiB 的 KV cache，因此\n"
+"      固定预算可保留 1M 支持，并留有约 2% 的余量。设置此选项后，\n"
+"      vLLM 会跳过 KV 内存 profiling，并且\n"
+"      `--gpu-memory-utilization` 不再决定 KV cache 大小；它\n"
+"      仍适用于其他内存预算逻辑。\n"
+"    - Prefix caching 仅在 Prefill 上启用。Decode 禁用它并\n"
+"      启用 `recompute_scheduler_enable`，以便在\n"
+"      Prefill 侧 KV cache 不可用时重新计算请求。\n"
+"    - Prefill 使用 `--enforce-eager` 和 `--swa-bounded-replay`。Decode 使用\n"
+"      `--async-scheduling`，使用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 捕获 Decode 路径，\n"
+"      并设置 `--no-swa-bounded-replay`，因为其\n"
+"      `recompute_scheduler_enable` 路径无法执行 bounded replay。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都将 `enable_flashcomm1` 设置为 `false`；在 Prefill 上这是\n"
+"      与 SWA bounded replay 兼容所必需的。Prefill 启用\n"
+"      `enable_fused_mc2` 和 `enable_shared_expert_dp`；Decode 则启用\n"
+"      `multistream_overlap_shared_expert`。\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` 和 socket 接口变量必须选择与所配置节点 IP\n"
+"      相同的高速服务网络。\n"
+"      `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1` 在 A2 上为节点内 HCCL 启用 RoCE 传输。\n"
+"      `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` 在 Prefill 上为 `1024`，在 Decode 上为 `1800`；\n"
+"      除非已验证其他设置，否则请保留这些角色特定的值。\n"
+"      `HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=\"AIV\"` 仅在 Prefill 上设置。\n"
+"    等待每个引擎完成权重加载，并且 Decode 完成图\n"
+"    捕获。成功启动会包含类似以下的输出："
+
+msgid ""
+"Before starting vLLM, configure `mooncake.json` for Prefill and\n"
+"`mooncake_d.json` for Decode, and start the mooncake_master Service. The\n"
+"Prefill and Decode nodes must export `MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH` pointing at the\n"
+"configuration file for their role."
+msgstr ""
+"在启动 vLLM 之前，为 Prefill 配置 `mooncake.json`，为 Decode 配置\n"
+"`mooncake_d.json`，并启动 mooncake_master Service。\n"
+"Prefill 和 Decode 节点必须导出 `MOONCAKE_CONFIG_PATH`，指向\n"
+"其角色对应的配置文件。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Prepare two Mooncake configuration files: `mooncake.json` for the Prefill\n"
+"ranks, which contribute the pool DRAM and offload evicted objects to SSD, and\n"
+"`mooncake_d.json` for the Decode ranks, which are pure consumers: they only\n"
+"read the pool and must not reserve host memory for it."
+msgstr ""
+"准备两个 Mooncake 配置文件：`mooncake.json` 用于 Prefill\n"
+"rank，它们贡献池 DRAM 并将被驱逐的对象卸载到 SSD；\n"
+"`mooncake_d.json` 用于 Decode rank，它们是纯消费者：它们只\n"
+"读取池，不得为其预留主机内存。"
+
+msgid "Configure the Prefill `mooncake.json`:"
+msgstr "配置 Prefill 的 `mooncake.json`："
+
+msgid ""
+"Keep `ssd_offload_path` equal to `SSD_OFFLOAD_ROOT` in the Prefill launcher\n"
+"script below. The two Prefill DP engines run with PCP4, so each of the eight\n"
+"devices registers one pool client and contributes `24GB`, giving the pool\n"
+"about `192GB` of DRAM capacity. Configure the Decode `mooncake_d.json` with\n"
+"zero contributed capacity and SSD offload disabled:"
+msgstr ""
+"在下面的 Prefill 启动脚本中，保持 `ssd_offload_path` 与 `SSD_OFFLOAD_ROOT`\n"
+"一致。两个 Prefill DP 引擎以 PCP4 运行，因此八个\n"
+"设备中的每一个都会注册一个池客户端并贡献 `24GB`，使池\n"
+"获得约 `192GB` 的 DRAM 容量。将 Decode 的 `mooncake_d.json` 配置为\n"
+"贡献容量为零并禁用 SSD 卸载："
+
+msgid ""
+"After the configurations are ready, start the mooncake_master process on the\n"
+"Prefill node; the validated configuration runs it there, and any node reachable\n"
+"from both roles works as well. Wait until the process stays alive and port\n"
+"`50088` is listening, which takes a few seconds:"
+msgstr ""
+"配置就绪后，在 Prefill 节点上启动 mooncake_master 进程；\n"
+"已验证的配置在该节点上运行它，任何可从两个角色访问的节点\n"
+"也可以。等待进程保持存活且端口\n"
+"`50088` 处于监听状态，这需要几秒钟："
+
+msgid ""
+"eviction_high_watermark_ratio determines the watermark where Mooncake Store will perform eviction.\n"
+"eviction_ratio determines the portion of stored objects that would be evicted.\n"
+"default_kv_lease_ttl controls the default lease TTL for KV objects (milliseconds).\n"
+"configure it via --default_kv_lease_ttl and keep it larger than ASCEND_CONNECT_TIMEOUT and ASCEND_TRANSFER_TIMEOUT.\n"
+"`--enable_offload` and `--offload_on_evict` enable the SSD tier, so objects\n"
+"evicted from pool DRAM are written under the Prefill node's `ssd_offload_path`\n"
+"instead of being dropped. `--client_ttl=120` keeps a slow-compiling worker from\n"
+"being removed from the pool during startup."
+msgstr ""
+"eviction_high_watermark_ratio 决定 Mooncake Store 执行驱逐的水位线。\n"
+"eviction_ratio 决定将被驱逐的已存储对象的比例。\n"
+"default_kv_lease_ttl 控制 KV 对象的默认租约 TTL（毫秒）。\n"
+"通过 --default_kv_lease_ttl 配置它，并保持其大于 ASCEND_CONNECT_TIMEOUT 和 ASCEND_TRANSFER_TIMEOUT。\n"
+"`--enable_offload` 和 `--offload_on_evict` 启用 SSD 层级，因此从池 DRAM\n"
+"驱逐的对象会写入 Prefill 节点的 `ssd_offload_path` 下，\n"
+"而不是被丢弃。`--client_ttl=120` 可防止编译缓慢的 worker\n"
+"在启动期间被从池中移除。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Complete [Section 5.4.3](#543-start-the-decode-node-with-pooling) first: the\n"
+"Prefill engines must start only after all Decode engines are ready."
+msgstr ""
+"请先完成[第 5.4.3 节](#543-start-the-decode-node-with-pooling)：\n"
+"Prefill 引擎必须仅在所有 Decode 引擎就绪后才能启动。"
+
+msgid ""
+"On the Prefill node, save the following script as `run_dp_template.sh`. Set\n"
+"`LOCAL_IP`, `NIC_NAME`, `MODEL_PATH`, `MOONCAKE_CONFIG_DIR`, and\n"
+"`SSD_OFFLOAD_ROOT` for the local environment."
+msgstr ""
+"在 Prefill 节点上，将以下脚本保存为 `run_dp_template.sh`。根据\n"
+"本地环境设置 `LOCAL_IP`、`NIC_NAME`、`MODEL_PATH`、`MOONCAKE_CONFIG_DIR` 和\n"
+"`SSD_OFFLOAD_ROOT`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`SSD_OFFLOAD_ROOT` must be a directory on a real SSD mount of the Prefill node,\n"
+"for example `/ssd_offload`. The script only runs `mkdir -p`: if the path points\n"
+"at the system disk, evicted objects are written there and can fill it, because\n"
+"each rank may cache up to `20GiB`."
+msgstr ""
+"`SSD_OFFLOAD_ROOT` 必须是 Prefill 节点上真实 SSD 挂载点中的目录，\n"
+"例如 `/ssd_offload`。脚本只会执行 `mkdir -p`：如果该路径指向\n"
+"系统盘，被驱逐的对象就会写入系统盘并可能将其填满，因为\n"
+"每个 rank 最多可缓存 `20GiB`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start the two DP2/TP1/PCP4 Prefill engines with the launcher command from "
+"[Section 5.2.2.2](#5222-start-the-prefill-node) after all Decode engines are"
+" ready."
+msgstr ""
+"在所有 Decode 引擎就绪后，使用 [第 5.2.2.2 节](#5222-start-the-prefill-node)中的启动命令启动两个 "
+"DP2/TP1/PCP4 Prefill 引擎。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start the eight DP8/TP1 Decode engines with the launcher command from "
+"[Section 5.2.2.3](#5223-start-the-decode-node)."
+msgstr ""
+"使用 [第 5.2.2.3 节](#5223-start-the-decode-node)中的启动命令启动八个 DP8/TP1 Decode 引擎。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `MultiConnector` combines live P-to-D transfer through `MooncakeHybridConnector` with persistent prefix reuse through `AscendStoreConnector`.\n"
+"- `backend: \"mooncake\"` selects Mooncake as the KV Cache Pool backend.\n"
+"- `use_layerwise: false` is required for DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash. Do not enable layerwise pooling for this model because its CED hybrid-attention structure is not supported by the layerwise path.\n"
+"- Prefill contributes the pool capacity (`global_segment_size` = `24GB` per rank) and enables SSD offload. Decode sets both `global_segment_size` and `local_buffer_size` to `0` and disables SSD offload, so it only reads the pool. Reserving pool DRAM on Decode can fail with `rtsHostRegister` out-of-memory errors and reduces the host memory available to the engines.\n"
+"- `PYTHONHASHSEED` must be `0` on both roles. The pool key is derived from block hashes; if the two sides disagree, lookups never hit.\n"
+"- The `MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_*` variables cap each Prefill rank's SSD bucket at `20GiB` and its staging buffer at `1GiB`. Adjust them to the SSD capacity available on the Prefill node."
+msgstr ""
+"- `MultiConnector` 通过 `MooncakeHybridConnector` 实现实时的 P 到 D 传输，并通过 `AscendStoreConnector` 实现持久化的前缀复用。\n"
+"- `backend: \"mooncake\"` 选择 Mooncake 作为 KV Cache Pool 后端。\n"
+"- DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 要求 `use_layerwise: false`。请勿为此模型启用 layerwise 池化，因为其 CED 混合注意力结构不受 layerwise 路径支持。\n"
+"- Prefill 贡献池容量（每个 rank 的 `global_segment_size` = `24GB`）并启用 SSD offload。Decode 将 `global_segment_size` 和 `local_buffer_size` 均设置为 `0` 并禁用 SSD offload，因此它只读取池。在 Decode 上预留池 DRAM 可能因 `rtsHostRegister` 内存不足错误而失败，并减少引擎可用的主机内存。\n"
+"- 两个角色的 `PYTHONHASHSEED` 都必须为 `0`。池键由块哈希派生；如果两侧不一致，查找将永远不会命中。\n"
+"- `MOONCAKE_OFFLOAD_*` 变量将每个 Prefill rank 的 SSD 桶上限设为 `20GiB`，将其暂存缓冲区上限设为 `1GiB`。请根据 Prefill 节点上可用的 SSD 容量进行调整。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This two-node colocated configuration uses two Atlas 800 A2 servers with one\n"
+"    local DP rank per server and a global DP2/TP8/EP16 topology. It uses the\n"
+"    W4A8 checkpoint and model runner V2 with DSpark speculative decoding and\n"
+"    `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` ACL Graph. This configuration has been validated for\n"
+"    startup, text and image smoke requests, and 16K-input serving; long-context\n"
+"    and high-concurrency performance has not been qualified."
+msgstr ""
+"此双节点混部配置使用两台 Atlas 800 A2 服务器，每台服务器一个\n"
+"    本地 DP rank，全局拓扑为 DP2/TP8/EP16。它使用\n"
+"    W4A8 权重和模型运行器 V2，并启用 DSpark 投机解码和\n"
+"    `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` ACL Graph。此配置已验证了\n"
+"    启动、文本和图像冒烟请求以及 16K 输入服务；长上下文\n"
+"    和高并发性能尚未验证。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The values in [Section 5.1](#51-single-node-colocated-deployment) and [Section 5.2](#52-1p1d-pd-disaggregated-deployment) are starting points rather than globally\n"
+"optimal settings. Tune `--max-num-seqs`, `--max-num-batched-tokens`, and\n"
+"`--gpu-memory-utilization` together for the target input length, image sizes,\n"
+"output length, and concurrency. Keep DP4/TP4 for A3 single-node deployment,\n"
+"or Prefill DP4/PCP4/TP1 and Decode DP16/TP1 for A3 PD deployment, until an\n"
+"alternative configuration has been validated. For A2 PD deployment, keep\n"
+"Prefill DP2/TP1/PCP4 with `--max-num-batched-tokens` at `4096` and Decode\n"
+"DP8/TP1 with `--kv-cache-memory-bytes` fixed, until an alternative\n"
+"configuration has been validated. On A2, `--max-num-batched-tokens` is a\n"
+"per-DP-rank budget, and raising it above `4096` on Prefill leaves too little\n"
+"KV cache for the 1M-token context. For the A2 two-node colocated deployment,\n"
+"keep `--gpu-memory-utilization` at `0.9`: each 64GB device already reports\n"
+"about 61.4 GiB of HBM in use at that setting, so higher values leave no\n"
+"headroom for the KV cache."
+msgstr ""
+"[第 5.1 节](#51-single-node-colocated-deployment)和[第 5.2 节](#52-1p1d-pd-disaggregated-deployment)中的值是起点，而非全局\n"
+"最优设置。请针对目标输入长度、图像尺寸、\n"
+"输出长度和并发量，联合调优 `--max-num-seqs`、`--max-num-batched-tokens` 和\n"
+"`--gpu-memory-utilization`。在替代配置经过验证之前，A3 单节点部署请保持 DP4/TP4，\n"
+"A3 PD 部署请保持 Prefill DP4/PCP4/TP1 和 Decode DP16/TP1。对于 A2 PD 部署，在替代\n"
+"配置经过验证之前，请保持 Prefill DP2/TP1/PCP4 且 `--max-num-batched-tokens` 为 `4096`，\n"
+"Decode DP8/TP1 且固定 `--kv-cache-memory-bytes`。在 A2 上，`--max-num-batched-tokens` 是\n"
+"每个 DP rank 的预算，在 Prefill 上将其提高到 `4096` 以上会为 1M token 上下文留下过少的\n"
+"KV cache。对于 A2 双节点混部部署，\n"
+"请保持 `--gpu-memory-utilization` 为 `0.9`：在该设置下，每台 64GB 设备已报告\n"
+"约 61.4 GiB 的 HBM 使用量，因此更高的值不会为 KV cache 留下\n"
+"余量。"
+

-msgid ""
-"3. Start P0 and P1 with `ROLE=p`, `KV_PORT=30000`, and the following\n"

-msgstr ""
-"3. 使用 `ROLE=p`、`KV_PORT=30000` 以及以下启动器参数启动 P0 和 P1。两个节点均在端口 `8000` 上提供 API "

-msgid ""

-msgstr ""

-msgid ""

-"           port `28000`, sends Prefill requests to both Prefill nodes, and forwards\n"
-"           Decode work to ports `8000-8003` on D0 and D1."
-msgstr ""
-"5. 在配置的代理主机上启动代理。生成的代理监听\n"
-"           端口 `28000`，将 Prefill 请求发送到两个 Prefill 节点，并将\n"

-msgid ""

-msgstr ""

-"           [第 6 节](#6-functional-verification)中的示例将推理请求发送到 `<PROXY_HOST_IP>:28000`。"

-"    加载/命中信息，以验证共享池复用。"

-msgid ""
-"GLM-5.3-Flash supports Prefill Context Parallelism (PCP), ReplaySSM\n"
-"(`--use-replayssm`), and BF16 SSM state (`--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`).\n"
-"The [A3 ordinary PD examples](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3) use these features together.\n"
-"The [A3 KV Cache Pool example](#glm53-flash-5-4-a3)\n"
-"uses native KDA because ReplaySSM does not support `MultiConnector`."
-msgstr ""
-"GLM-5.3-Flash 支持 Prefill 上下文并行（PCP）、ReplaySSM\n"
-"（`--use-replayssm`）以及 BF16 SSM 状态（`--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`）。\n"
-"[A3 普通 PD 示例](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3) 将这些特性结合使用。\n"
-"[A3 KV Cache Pool 示例](#glm53-flash-5-4-a3)\n"
-"使用原生 KDA，因为 ReplaySSM 不支持 `MultiConnector`。"
-
-msgid ""
-"- `--data-parallel-size 1`: Runs a single DP rank. `--tensor-parallel-size` is 8 on 950DT products and 16 on A3 series. This layout is recommended to balance memory capacity and compute efficiency for the w8a8 weights.\n"
-"- `--enable-expert-parallel`: Must be enabled for the MoE architecture of GLM-5.3-Flash.\n"
-"- `--quantization ascend`: Enables Ascend quantization for the w8a8 quantized weights.\n"
-"- `--kv-cache-dtype`: Enables 8-bit KV cache quantization (C8) for Sparse Flash Attention (SFA).\n"
-"  Use C8 when long contexts or concurrent requests are limited by KV cache memory.\n"
-"  The complete single-node commands above use `fp8` on 950DT products and `int8` on A3 series.\n"
-"  KV cache quantization is independent of weight quantization: enabling C8 does not require W8A8 weights or a separate C8 checkpoint.\n"
-"  The examples use W8A8-MXFP8 weights on 950DT products and W8A8 weights on A3 series, as listed in Section 3.1.\n"
-"- `--attention-config.indexer_kv_dtype`: Uses FP8 KPool indexer cache on 950DT products and INT8 on A3 series, independently of `--kv-cache-dtype`.\n"
-"- `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`: Uses BF16 SSM state in the A3 series single-node example.\n"
-"- `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'`: Enables graph capture for the decode phase only, improving decode performance by reducing kernel launch overhead.\n"
-"- `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\":1,\"video\":0}'`: Allows at most one image per prompt and disables video input where specified. A3 ordinary PD uses `'{\"image\":1}'` to limit image input only.\n"
-"- `--speculative-config`: Enables Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) speculative decoding with the DeepSeek-style MTP draft head of GLM-5.3-Flash. The single-node examples use five speculative tokens. GLM-5.3-Flash supports MTP draft graph execution."
-msgstr ""
-"- `--data-parallel-size 1`：运行单个 DP rank。`--tensor-parallel-size` 在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上为 8，在 A3系列上为 16。推荐采用此布局，以在 w8a8 权重下平衡内存容量与计算效率。\n"
-"- `--enable-expert-parallel`：必须为 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 MoE 架构启用。\n"
-"- `--quantization ascend`：为 w8a8 量化权重启用昇腾量化。\n"
-"- `--kv-cache-dtype`：为稀疏 Flash Attention（SFA）启用 8 位 KV cache 量化（C8）。\n"
-"  当长上下文或并发请求受限于 KV cache 内存时，请使用 C8。\n"
-"  上述完整的单节点命令在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 `fp8`，在 A3系列上使用 `int8`。\n"
-"  KV cache 量化与权重量化相互独立：启用 C8 不需要 W8A8 权重，也不需要单独的 C8 checkpoint。\n"
-"  如第 3.1 节所列，示例在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 W8A8-MXFP8 权重，在 A3系列上使用 W8A8 权重。\n"
-"- `--attention-config.indexer_kv_dtype`：在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 FP8 KPool indexer cache，在 A3系列上使用 INT8，与 `--kv-cache-dtype` 相互独立。\n"
-"- `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`：在 A3系列单节点示例中使用 BF16 SSM 状态。\n"
-"- `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'`：仅为 decode 阶段启用图捕获，通过减少 kernel 启动开销来提升 decode 性能。\n"
-"- `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\":1,\"video\":0}'`：每个 prompt 最多允许一张图像，并在指定位置禁用视频输入。A3 普通 PD 使用 `'{\"image\":1}'` 仅限制图像输入。\n"
-"- `--speculative-config`：使用 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 DeepSeek 风格 MTP draft head 启用多 Token 预测（MTP）投机解码。单节点示例使用五个投机 Token。GLM-5.3-Flash 支持 MTP draft 图执行。"
-

-msgid ""
-"- `--data-parallel-size`, `--tensor-parallel-size`, and\n"
-"      `--prefill-context-parallel-size` define TP1/PCP8/DP1 on Prefill\n"
-"      and TP1/PCP1/DP8 on Decode. Each role uses eight devices on one node.\n"
-"      Prefill runs one eight-device engine. `--device-ids \"$1\"` binds each\n"
-"      engine to the device list passed by the launcher: devices `0-7` for\n"
-"      Prefill and one device per DP rank for Decode.\n"
-"    - `--data-parallel-address` and `--data-parallel-rpc-port` coordinate\n"
-"      ranks within each role. Prefill and Decode use their respective node\n"
-"      IPs; RPC port `12325` is reused on the separate hosts.\n"
-"    - `--vllm-start-port 8000` assigns Prefill API port `8000` and Decode\n"
-"      API ports `8000-8007`. Register all eight Decode endpoints with the\n"
-"      proxy.\n"
-"    - Both roles use `--max-model-len 133120`, `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, and\n"
-"      `deepseek_mtp` with five speculative tokens.\n"
-"    - Prefill sets `--max-num-seqs 256` and\n"
-"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 24576`; Decode sets `30` and `120`,\n"
-"      respectively. Tune these per-engine scheduler limits for the workload.\n"
-"    - Prefill enables shared-expert multistream overlap, with\n"
-"      `enable_fused_mc2: 0`.\n"
-"      Decode enables shared-expert multistream overlap, recomputation\n"
-"      scheduling and `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` for target and MTP draft. Prefill\n"
-"      target and draft are eager. FlashComm1 and shared-expert DP require\n"
-"      TP>1 and are therefore not enabled on either role.\n"
-"    - Prefill uses PCP8, while Decode keeps the default PCP1. Both roles\n"
-"      keep the default DCP1. For PCP configuration, refer to\n"
-"      [Context Parallel](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md).\n"
-"    - Both roles enable prefix caching and allow one image per prompt,\n"
-"      with video input disabled through `--limit-mm-per-prompt`.\n"
-"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` uses `kv_producer` on Prefill and `kv_consumer`\n"
-"      on Decode, with base KV ports `30100` and `30800`, respectively.\n"
-"      Both roles declare Prefill TP1/PCP8/DP1 and Decode TP1/PCP1/DP8.\n"
-"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` and the socket interface variables select each node's\n"
-"      communication network. `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` is `3072` on Prefill and\n"
-"      `1024` on Decode. The DP RPC, API, Mooncake and proxy ports must be\n"
-"      reachable between the corresponding hosts."
-msgstr ""
-"- `--data-parallel-size`、`--tensor-parallel-size` 和\n"
-"      `--prefill-context-parallel-size` 在 Prefill 上定义 TP1/PCP8/DP1，\n"
-"      在 Decode 上定义 TP1/PCP1/DP8。每个角色在一个节点上使用八个设备。\n"
-"      Prefill 运行一个八设备引擎。`--device-ids \"$1\"` 将每个引擎绑定到\n"
-"      启动器传入的设备列表：Prefill 使用设备 `0-7`，Decode 每个 DP rank\n"
-"      使用一个设备。\n"
-"    - `--data-parallel-address` 和 `--data-parallel-rpc-port` 协调\n"
-"      每个角色内的 rank。Prefill 和 Decode 使用各自的节点 IP；\n"
-"      RPC 端口 `12325` 在不同主机上重复使用。\n"
-"    - `--vllm-start-port 8000` 为 Prefill 分配 API 端口 `8000`，为 Decode\n"
-"      分配 API 端口 `8000-8007`。将所有八个 Decode 端点注册到\n"
-"      代理。\n"
-"    - 两个角色都使用 `--max-model-len 133120`、`--kv-cache-dtype fp8` 和\n"
-"      `deepseek_mtp`，并启用五个投机 token。\n"
-"    - Prefill 设置 `--max-num-seqs 256` 和\n"
-"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 24576`；Decode 分别设置为 `30` 和 `120`。\n"
-"      请根据工作负载调整这些每引擎调度器限制。\n"
-"    - Prefill 启用共享专家多流重叠，并设置\n"
-"      `enable_fused_mc2: 0`。\n"
-"      Decode 启用共享专家多流重叠、重计算\n"
-"      调度以及针对 target 和 MTP draft 的 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`。Prefill\n"
-"      的 target 和 draft 为 eager 模式。FlashComm1 和共享专家 DP 需要\n"
-"      TP>1，因此两个角色均未启用。\n"
-"    - Prefill 使用 PCP8，而 Decode 保持默认的 PCP1。两个角色\n"
-"      都保持默认的 DCP1。有关 PCP 配置，请参阅\n"
-"      [上下文并行](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md)。\n"
-"    - 两个角色都启用前缀缓存，并允许每个 prompt 一张图像，\n"
-"      通过 `--limit-mm-per-prompt` 禁用视频输入。\n"
-"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` 在 Prefill 上使用 `kv_producer`，在 Decode 上\n"
-"      使用 `kv_consumer`，基础 KV 端口分别为 `30100` 和 `30800`。\n"
-"      两个角色都声明 Prefill TP1/PCP8/DP1 和 Decode TP1/PCP1/DP8。\n"
-"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` 和 socket 接口变量选择每个节点的\n"
-"      通信网络。`HCCL_BUFFSIZE` 在 Prefill 上为 `3072`，在 Decode 上为\n"
-"      `1024`。DP RPC、API、Mooncake 和代理端口必须在\n"
-"      相应主机之间可达。"

-msgid ""
-"- Prefill uses DP2/TP1/PCP8: each of its two engines receives eight\n"
-"      devices from `launch_online_dp.py`. Decode uses DP8/TP2: each of its\n"
-"      eight engines receives two devices. Both roles use all 16 logical devices\n"
-"      on their respective A3 series nodes.\n"
-"    - `--data-parallel-address` and `--data-parallel-rpc-port` coordinate DP\n"
-"      ranks within one role. Prefill and Decode use their respective node IPs.\n"
-"      The default RPC port `12325` can be reused on the separate hosts.\n"
-"    - `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"` selects the launcher-assigned devices\n"
-"      for each engine.\n"
-"    - Prefill API ports are `9081-9082`; Decode API ports are `9900-9907`.\n"
-"      All ten endpoints must be reachable from the proxy.\n"
-"    - Both roles use Model Runner V2, INT8 main and indexer KV caches,\n"
-"      `--max-model-len 1048576`, MTP3, `--use-replayssm`, and\n"
-"      `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`. Prefix caching uses the model default.\n"
-"      Refer to [GLM KDA RecoverSSM](../../user_guide/feature_guide/speculative_decoding.md)\n"
-"      for the ReplaySSM switch and its requirements.\n"
-"    - Prefill runs the target eagerly and enables draft graph execution.\n"
-"      It enables asynchronous EPLB with the `stair` policy and `hixl`\n"
-"      communicator. The Prefill configuration sets `enable_fused_mc2` to `2`\n"
-"      and `enable_shared_expert_dp` to `true`.\n"
-"    - Prefill uses `--max-num-seqs 32` and\n"
-"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`. Decode uses `40` and `240`, respectively.\n"
-"    - Decode uses `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` with default capture sizes, FlashComm1,\n"
-"      shared-expert DP and multistream\n"
-"      overlap. Recompute scheduling is enabled through `scheduler_config`.\n"
-"    - Both roles explicitly limit image input to one image per prompt.\n"
-"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` uses `kv_producer` and engine ID `0` on Prefill,\n"
-"      and `kv_consumer` and engine ID `1` on Decode. These IDs identify the\n"
-"      roles in this deployment. Base KV ports are `36680` and `36580`.\n"
-"    - The HCCS resource settings select device communication; `HCCL_IF_IP`\n"
-"      and the socket interface variables select the host network. The DP RPC,\n"
-"      API, Mooncake and proxy ports must be available on the respective hosts."
-msgstr ""
-"- Prefill 使用 DP2/TP1/PCP8：其两个引擎各自从 `launch_online_dp.py`\n"
-"      获得八个设备。Decode 使用 DP8/TP2：其八个引擎各自获得两个设备。\n"
-"      两个角色都使用各自 A3 系列节点上的全部 16 个逻辑设备。\n"
-"    - `--data-parallel-address` 和 `--data-parallel-rpc-port` 用于协调\n"
-"      同一角色内的 DP rank。Prefill 和 Decode 使用各自的节点 IP。\n"
-"      默认 RPC 端口 `12325` 可以在不同主机上复用。\n"
-"    - `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"` 用于为每个引擎选择启动器分配的设备。\n"
-"    - Prefill API 端口为 `9081-9082`；Decode API 端口为 `9900-9907`。\n"
-"      全部十个端点都必须能从代理访问。\n"
-"    - 两个角色都使用 Model Runner V2、INT8 主 KV 缓存和 indexer KV 缓存、\n"
-"      `--max-model-len 1048576`、MTP3、`--use-replayssm` 以及\n"
-"      `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`。前缀缓存使用模型默认值。\n"
-"      关于 ReplaySSM 开关及其要求，请参阅\n"
-"      [GLM KDA RecoverSSM](../../user_guide/feature_guide/speculative_decoding.md)。\n"
-"    - Prefill 以 eager 模式运行目标模型，并启用 draft 图执行。\n"
-"      它启用异步 EPLB，使用 `stair` 策略和 `hixl` 通信器。\n"
-"      Prefill 配置将 `enable_fused_mc2` 设置为 `2`，\n"
-"      并将 `enable_shared_expert_dp` 设置为 `true`。\n"
-"    - Prefill 使用 `--max-num-seqs 32` 和\n"
-"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`。Decode 分别使用 `40` 和 `240`。\n"
-"    - Decode 使用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 及默认捕获大小、FlashComm1、\n"
-"      共享专家 DP 和多流重叠。重计算调度通过 `scheduler_config` 启用。\n"
-"    - 两个角色都显式将图像输入限制为每个提示一张图像。\n"
-"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` 在 Prefill 上使用 `kv_producer` 和引擎 ID `0`，\n"
-"      在 Decode 上使用 `kv_consumer` 和引擎 ID `1`。这些 ID 用于标识\n"
-"      此部署中的角色。基础 KV 端口为 `36680` 和 `36580`。\n"
-"    - HCCS 资源配置选择设备通信；`HCCL_IF_IP`\n"
-"      和套接字接口变量选择主机网络。DP RPC、\n"
-"      API、Mooncake 和代理端口必须在相应主机上可用。"

-msgid ""
-"- A2 series uses global DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill and DP8/TP2 Decode, with each\n"
-"      role spread across two nodes with eight devices per node. A3 ordinary PD uses\n"
-"      DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill and DP8/TP2 Decode, each on one node with 16 logical devices.\n"
-"    - P0 and P1 use the shared launcher with one local DP rank each. P0\n"
-"      exposes the Prefill API with `--api-server-count 1`; P1 is headless.\n"
-"      D0 and D1 each run four API-serving TP2 engines(total DP8) through their\n"
-"      node-specific wrapper scripts.\n"
-"    - `kv_connector_extra_config` enables `use_ascend_direct` for direct\n"
-"      NPU-to-NPU KV transfer and declares the actual Prefill and Decode\n"
-"      `{dp_size, tp_size, pcp_size}` topology. The declared values must match the\n"
-"      real deployment.\n"
-"    - Prefill uses `--max-num-seqs 64` and `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`\n"
-"      without `--enforce-eager`; Decode uses `--max-num-seqs 60` and\n"
-"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 192` with `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode.\n"
-"      Both roles run with `--async-scheduling`.\n"
-"    - Both roles use Model Runner V2 via `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`.\n"
-"      Prefill uses PCP8 and TP1; Decode keeps PCP1.\n"
-"      `--device-ids \"$1\"` binds each engine to the launcher-assigned devices.\n"
-"      `VLLM_HOST_IP` advertises the IP that peers use to reach each\n"
-"      engine for KV transfer.\n"
-"    - MTP speculative decoding uses five speculative tokens on A2 series.\n"
-"      Prefill uses `enforce_eager: true`; Decode uses `enforce_eager: false`\n"
-"      with `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode.\n"
-"    - `HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` and `HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` on\n"
-"      Decode reserve a disjoint 100-port window per DP rank (starting at\n"
-"      `60000 + rank * 100`). When several engines share one node, these\n"
-"      ranges prevent the HCCL host-side sockets from silently sharing\n"
-"      ports across ranks, which can block engine startup.\n"
-"    - The remaining timeout and runtime variables\n"
-"      (`VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT`,\n"
-"      `HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`, `VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT`, `OMP_PROC_BIND`,\n"
-"      `OMP_NUM_THREADS`) are the validated A2 series startup defaults for this\n"
-"      model size; keep them unless your environment requires different\n"
