+
+msgid ""
+"The [A3 ordinary PD examples](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3) use Prefill Context\n"
+"Parallelism (PCP) and BF16 SSM state (`--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`)."
+msgstr ""
+"[A3 普通 PD 示例](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3)使用预填充上下文并行（PCP）和 BF16 SSM 状态（`--mamba-ssm-"
+"cache-dtype bfloat16`）。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size 1`: Runs a single DP rank. `--tensor-parallel-size` is 8 on 950DT products and 16 on A3 series. This layout is recommended to balance memory capacity and compute efficiency for the w8a8 weights.\n"
+"- `--enable-expert-parallel`: Must be enabled for the MoE architecture of GLM-5.3-Flash.\n"
+"- `--quantization ascend`: Enables Ascend quantization for the w8a8 quantized weights.\n"
+"- `--kv-cache-dtype`: Enables 8-bit KV cache quantization (C8) for Sparse Flash Attention (SFA).\n"
+"  Use C8 when long contexts or concurrent requests are limited by KV cache memory.\n"
+"  The complete single-node commands above use `fp8` on 950DT products and `int8` on A3 series.\n"
+"  KV cache quantization is independent of weight quantization: enabling C8 does not require W8A8 weights or a separate C8 checkpoint.\n"
+"  The examples use W8A8-MXFP8 weights on 950DT products and W8A8 weights on A3 series, as listed in Section 3.1.\n"
+"- `--attention-config.indexer_kv_dtype`: Uses FP8 KPool indexer cache on 950DT products, independently of `--kv-cache-dtype`. The A3 series example leaves the indexer cache dtype at its default.\n"
+"- `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`: Uses BF16 SSM state in the A3 series single-node example.\n"
+"- `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'`: Enables graph capture for the decode phase only, improving decode performance by reducing kernel launch overhead.\n"
+"- `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\":1,\"video\":0}'`: Allows at most one image per prompt and disables video input where specified. A3 ordinary PD uses `'{\"image\":1}'` to limit image input only.\n"
+"- `--speculative-config`: Enables Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) speculative decoding with the DeepSeek-style MTP draft head of GLM-5.3-Flash. The single-node examples use five speculative tokens. GLM-5.3-Flash supports MTP draft graph execution."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size 1`：运行单个 DP rank。`--tensor-parallel-size` 在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上为 8，在 A3 系列上为 16。推荐采用此布局，以在 w8a8 权重下平衡内存容量与计算效率。\n"
+"- `--enable-expert-parallel`：对于 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 MoE 架构，必须启用此选项。\n"
+"- `--quantization ascend`：为 w8a8 量化权重启用昇腾量化。\n"
+"- `--kv-cache-dtype`：为稀疏 Flash Attention（SFA）启用 8 位 KV cache 量化（C8）。\n"
+"  当长上下文或并发请求受限于 KV cache 内存时，请使用 C8。\n"
+"  上述完整的单节点命令在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 `fp8`，在 A3 系列上使用 `int8`。\n"
+"  KV cache 量化与权重量化相互独立：启用 C8 不需要 W8A8 权重，也不需要单独的 C8 checkpoint。\n"
+"  如第 3.1 节所列，示例在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 W8A8-MXFP8 权重，在 A3 系列上使用 W8A8 权重。\n"
+"- `--attention-config.indexer_kv_dtype`：在 Ascend 950DT系列产品上使用 FP8 KPool indexer cache，与 `--kv-cache-dtype` 相互独立。A3 系列示例将 indexer cache dtype 保留为默认值。\n"
+"- `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`：在 A3 系列单节点示例中使用 BF16 SSM 状态。\n"
+"- `--compilation-config '{\"cudagraph_mode\": \"FULL_DECODE_ONLY\"}'`：仅为 decode 阶段启用图捕获，通过减少 kernel 启动开销来提升 decode 性能。\n"
+"- `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\":1,\"video\":0}'`：每个 prompt 最多允许一张图像，并在指定处禁用视频输入。A3 普通 PD 使用 `'{\"image\":1}'` 仅限制图像输入。\n"
+"- `--speculative-config`：使用 GLM-5.3-Flash 的 DeepSeek 风格 MTP draft head 启用多 Token 预测（MTP）投机解码。单节点示例使用五个投机 token。GLM-5.3-Flash 支持 MTP draft 图执行。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size`, `--tensor-parallel-size`, and\n"
+"      `--prefill-context-parallel-size` define TP1/PCP8/DP1 on Prefill\n"
+"      and TP1/PCP1/DP8 on Decode. Each role uses eight devices on one node.\n"
+"      Prefill runs one eight-device engine. `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"` binds each\n"
+"      engine to the device list passed by the launcher: devices `0-7` for\n"
+"      Prefill and one device per DP rank for Decode.\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` and `--data-parallel-rpc-port` coordinate\n"
+"      ranks within each role. Prefill and Decode use their respective node\n"
+"      IPs; RPC port `12325` is reused on the separate hosts.\n"
+"    - `--vllm-start-port 8000` assigns Prefill API port `8000` and Decode\n"
+"      API ports `8000-8007`. Register all eight Decode endpoints with the\n"
+"      proxy.\n"
+"    - Both roles use `--max-model-len 1048576`, `--kv-cache-dtype fp8`, and\n"
+"      `deepseek_mtp` with five speculative tokens.\n"
+"    - Prefill sets `--max-num-seqs 128` and\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 32768`; Decode sets `60` and `360`,\n"
+"      respectively. Tune these per-engine scheduler limits for the workload.\n"
+"    - Prefill enables CPU binding and disables FlashComm1, fused MC2,\n"
+"      shared-expert DP and multistream overlap. Its target and MTP draft\n"
+"      run eagerly. Decode uses `enable_fused_mc2: 2`, shared-expert\n"
+"      multistream overlap and recomputation scheduling through `scheduler_config`.\n"
+"      Decode uses `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` with `enable_npugraph_ex: true`,\n"
+"      while static and super kernels are disabled.\n"
+"    - Prefill uses PCP8, while Decode keeps the default PCP1. Both roles\n"
+"      keep the default DCP1. For PCP configuration, refer to\n"
+"      [Context Parallel](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md).\n"
+"    - Both roles enable prefix caching and disable video input through\n"
+"      `--limit-mm-per-prompt`. Images retain the runtime default limit.\n"
+"      `--allowed-local-media-path /` permits local media under the container root.\n"
+"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` transfers KV cache directly between the roles. It uses\n"
+"      `kv_producer` on Prefill and `kv_consumer` on Decode, with base KV ports\n"
+"      `30000` and `30800`. Both roles declare Prefill TP1/PCP8/DP1 and\n"
+"      Decode TP1/PCP1/DP8; Decode enables `use_ascend_direct`.\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` and the socket interface variables select each node's\n"
+"      communication network. `HCCL_BUFFSIZE` is `2048` on Prefill and\n"
+"      `1024` on Decode. The DP RPC, API, Mooncake and proxy ports must be\n"
+"      reachable between the corresponding hosts."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--data-parallel-size`、`--tensor-parallel-size` 和\n"
+"      `--prefill-context-parallel-size` 在 Prefill 上定义 TP1/PCP8/DP1，\n"
+"      在 Decode 上定义 TP1/PCP1/DP8。每个角色在一个节点上使用八个设备。\n"
+"      Prefill 运行一个八设备引擎。`ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"` 将每个\n"
+"      引擎绑定到启动器传入的设备列表：Prefill 使用设备 `0-7`，\n"
+"      Decode 每个 DP rank 使用一个设备。\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` 和 `--data-parallel-rpc-port` 协调\n"
+"      每个角色内的 rank。Prefill 和 Decode 使用各自的节点\n"
+"      IP；RPC 端口 `12325` 在不同主机上复用。\n"
+"    - `--vllm-start-port 8000` 分配 Prefill API 端口 `8000` 和 Decode\n"
+"      API 端口 `8000-8007`。将所有八个 Decode 端点注册到\n"
+"      代理。\n"
+"    - 两个角色均使用 `--max-model-len 1048576`、`--kv-cache-dtype fp8` 和\n"
+"      `deepseek_mtp`，并使用五个投机 token。\n"
+"    - Prefill 设置 `--max-num-seqs 128` 和\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 32768`；Decode 分别设置为 `60` 和 `360`。\n"
+"      请根据工作负载调整这些每引擎调度器限制。\n"
+"    - Prefill 启用 CPU 绑定并禁用 FlashComm1、融合 MC2、\n"
+"      共享专家 DP 和多流重叠。其 target 和 MTP draft\n"
+"      以 eager 模式运行。Decode 通过 `scheduler_config` 使用 `enable_fused_mc2: 2`、共享专家\n"
+"      多流重叠和重计算调度。\n"
+"      Decode 使用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 并设置 `enable_npugraph_ex: true`，\n"
+"      同时禁用 static 和 super kernel。\n"
+"    - Prefill 使用 PCP8，而 Decode 保持默认的 PCP1。两个角色\n"
+"      均保持默认的 DCP1。有关 PCP 配置，请参阅\n"
+"      [上下文并行](../../user_guide/feature_guide/context_parallel.md)。\n"
+"    - 两个角色均启用前缀缓存，并通过\n"
+"      `--limit-mm-per-prompt` 禁用视频输入。图像保留运行时默认限制。\n"
+"      `--allowed-local-media-path /` 允许容器根目录下的本地媒体。\n"
+"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` 在角色之间直接传输 KV cache。它在 Prefill 上使用\n"
+"      `kv_producer`，在 Decode 上使用 `kv_consumer`，基础 KV 端口为\n"
+"      `30000` 和 `30800`。两个角色均声明 Prefill TP1/PCP8/DP1 和\n"
+"      Decode TP1/PCP1/DP8；Decode 启用 `use_ascend_direct`。\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` 和 socket 接口变量选择每个节点的\n"
+"      通信网络。`HCCL_BUFFSIZE` 在 Prefill 上为 `2048`，在\n"
+"      Decode 上为 `1024`。DP RPC、API、Mooncake 和代理端口必须在\n"
+"      相应主机之间可达。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Prefill uses DP2/TP1/PCP8: each of its two engines receives eight\n"
+"      devices from `launch_online_dp.py`. Decode uses DP8/TP2: each of its\n"
+"      eight engines receives two devices. Both roles use all 16 logical devices\n"
+"      on their respective A3 series nodes.\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` and `--data-parallel-rpc-port` coordinate DP\n"
+"      ranks within one role. Prefill and Decode use their respective node IPs.\n"
+"      The default RPC port `12325` can be reused on the separate hosts.\n"
+"    - `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"` selects the launcher-assigned devices\n"
+"      for each engine.\n"
+"    - Prefill API ports are `9081-9082`; Decode API ports are `9900-9907`.\n"
+"      All ten endpoints must be reachable from the proxy.\n"
+"    - Both roles use Model Runner V2, INT8 main KV cache,\n"
+"      `--max-model-len 1048576`, MTP3, and\n"
+"      `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`. Prefix caching uses the model default.\n"
+"    - Prefill runs the target eagerly and enables draft graph execution.\n"
+"      It enables asynchronous EPLB with the `stair` policy and `hixl`\n"
+"      communicator. The Prefill configuration sets `enable_fused_mc2` to `2`\n"
+"      and `enable_shared_expert_dp` to `true`.\n"
+"    - Prefill uses `--max-num-seqs 32` and\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`. Decode uses `40` and `240`, respectively.\n"
+"    - Decode uses `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` with default capture sizes, FlashComm1,\n"
+"      shared-expert DP and multistream\n"
+"      overlap. Recompute scheduling is enabled through `scheduler_config`.\n"
+"    - Both roles explicitly limit image input to one image per prompt.\n"
+"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` uses `kv_producer` and engine ID `0` on Prefill,\n"
+"      and `kv_consumer` and engine ID `1` on Decode. These IDs identify the\n"
+"      roles in this deployment. Base KV ports are `36680` and `36580`.\n"
+"    - The HCCS resource settings select device communication; `HCCL_IF_IP`\n"
+"      and the socket interface variables select the host network. The DP RPC,\n"
+"      API, Mooncake and proxy ports must be available on the respective hosts."
+msgstr ""
+"- Prefill 使用 DP2/TP1/PCP8：其两个引擎各自从 `launch_online_dp.py`\n"
+"      接收八个设备。Decode 使用 DP8/TP2：其八个引擎各自接收两个设备。\n"
+"      两个角色都使用各自 A3 系列节点上的全部 16 个逻辑设备。\n"
+"    - `--data-parallel-address` 和 `--data-parallel-rpc-port` 用于协调同一角色内的\n"
+"      DP rank。Prefill 和 Decode 使用各自的节点 IP。\n"
+"      默认 RPC 端口 `12325` 可以在不同主机上复用。\n"
+"    - `ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES=\"$1\"` 为每个引擎选择由启动器分配的设备。\n"
+"    - Prefill API 端口为 `9081-9082`；Decode API 端口为 `9900-9907`。\n"
+"      全部十个端点都必须能从代理访问。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都使用 Model Runner V2、INT8 主 KV cache、\n"
+"      `--max-model-len 1048576`、MTP3 以及\n"
+"      `--mamba-ssm-cache-dtype bfloat16`。前缀缓存使用模型默认配置。\n"
+"    - Prefill 以 eager 模式运行目标模型，并启用 draft 图执行。\n"
+"      它启用异步 EPLB，使用 `stair` 策略和 `hixl`\n"
+"      通信器。Prefill 配置将 `enable_fused_mc2` 设为 `2`，\n"
+"      并将 `enable_shared_expert_dp` 设为 `true`。\n"
+"    - Prefill 使用 `--max-num-seqs 32` 和\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 16384`。Decode 分别使用 `40` 和 `240`。\n"
+"    - Decode 使用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`，采用默认捕获大小、FlashComm1、\n"
+"      共享专家 DP 和多流\n"
+"      重叠。通过 `scheduler_config` 启用重计算调度。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都显式限制每个 prompt 只能输入一张图像。\n"
+"    - `MooncakeConnectorV2` 在 Prefill 上使用 `kv_producer` 和引擎 ID `0`，\n"
+"      在 Decode 上使用 `kv_consumer` 和引擎 ID `1`。这些 ID 用于标识此部署中的\n"
+"      角色。基础 KV 端口为 `36680` 和 `36580`。\n"
+"    - HCCS 资源配置用于选择设备通信；`HCCL_IF_IP`\n"
+"      和套接字接口变量用于选择主机网络。DP RPC、\n"
+"      API、Mooncake 和代理端口必须在各自主机上可用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- A2 series uses global DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill and DP8/TP2 Decode, with each\n"
+"      role spread across two nodes with eight devices per node. A3 ordinary PD uses\n"
+"      DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill and DP8/TP2 Decode, each on one node with 16 logical devices.\n"
+"    - P0 and P1 use the shared launcher with one local DP rank each. P0\n"
+"      exposes the Prefill API with `--api-server-count 1`; P1 is headless.\n"
+"      D0 and D1 each run four API-serving TP2 engines(total DP8) through their\n"
+"      node-specific wrapper scripts.\n"
+"    - `kv_connector_extra_config` enables `use_ascend_direct` for direct\n"
+"      NPU-to-NPU KV transfer and declares the actual Prefill and Decode\n"
+"      `{dp_size, tp_size, pcp_size}` topology. The declared values must match the\n"
+"      real deployment.\n"
+"    - Prefill uses `--max-num-seqs 64` and `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`\n"
+"      without `--enforce-eager`; Decode uses `--max-num-seqs 40` and\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 240` with `gpu-memory-utilization=0.92` and\n"
+"      `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode.\n"
+"      Both roles run with `--async-scheduling`.\n"
+"    - Both roles use Model Runner V2 via `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`.\n"
+"      Prefill uses PCP8 and TP1; Decode keeps PCP1.\n"
+"      `--device-ids \"$1\"` binds each engine to the launcher-assigned devices.\n"
+"      `VLLM_HOST_IP` advertises the IP that peers use to reach each\n"
+"      engine for KV transfer. Prefill enables FlashComm1 and shared-expert DP;\n"
+"      Decode enables the recompute scheduler and NPU graph extension while\n"
+"      keeping FlashComm1 disabled and static/super kernels disabled.\n"
+"    - MTP speculative decoding uses three speculative tokens on A2 series.\n"
+"      Prefill uses `enforce_eager: true`; Decode uses `enforce_eager: false`\n"
+"      with `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` graph mode.\n"
+"    - `HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` and `HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` on\n"
+"      Decode reserve a disjoint 100-port window per DP rank (starting at\n"
+"      `60000 + rank * 100`). When several engines share one node, these\n"
+"      ranges prevent the HCCL host-side sockets from silently sharing\n"
+"      ports across ranks, which can block engine startup.\n"
+"    - The remaining timeout and runtime variables\n"
+"      (`VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`, `HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT`,\n"
+"      `HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`, `VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT`, `OMP_PROC_BIND`,\n"
+"      `OMP_NUM_THREADS`) are the validated A2 series startup defaults for this\n"
+"      model size; keep them unless your environment requires different\n"
+"      values.\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` and all socket interface variables must select the\n"
+"      service network used by the configured node IPs. The DP RPC,\n"
+"      engine, Mooncake, and proxy ports must be allowed by the host\n"
+"      firewall."
+msgstr ""
+"- A2 系列使用全局 DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill 和 DP8/TP2 Decode，每个\n"
+"      角色分布在两个节点上，每个节点八个设备。A3 普通 PD 使用\n"
+"      DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill 和 DP8/TP2 Decode，各自位于一个节点上，使用 16 个逻辑设备。\n"
+"    - P0 和 P1 使用共享启动器，各自拥有一个本地 DP rank。P0\n"
+"      通过 `--api-server-count 1` 暴露 Prefill API；P1 为无头模式。\n"
+"      D0 和 D1 各自通过其节点专属的包装脚本运行四个提供 API 服务的 TP2 引擎（总计 DP8）。\n"
+"    - `kv_connector_extra_config` 启用 `use_ascend_direct` 以实现\n"
+"      NPU 到 NPU 的直接 KV 传输，并声明实际的 Prefill 和 Decode\n"
+"      `{dp_size, tp_size, pcp_size}` 拓扑。声明的值必须与\n"
+"      实际部署一致。\n"
+"    - Prefill 使用 `--max-num-seqs 64` 和 `--max-num-batched-tokens 4096`，\n"
+"      不使用 `--enforce-eager`；Decode 使用 `--max-num-seqs 40` 和\n"
+"      `--max-num-batched-tokens 240`，并设置 `gpu-memory-utilization=0.92` 和\n"
+"      `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式。\n"
+"      两个角色都使用 `--async-scheduling` 运行。\n"
+"    - 两个角色都通过 `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1` 使用 Model Runner V2。\n"
+"      Prefill 使用 PCP8 和 TP1；Decode 保持 PCP1。\n"
+"      `--device-ids \"$1\"` 将每个引擎绑定到启动器分配的设备。\n"
+"      `VLLM_HOST_IP` 通告对等节点用于访问每个引擎以进行 KV 传输的 IP。\n"
+"      Prefill 启用 FlashComm1 和共享专家 DP；\n"
+"      Decode 启用重计算调度器和 NPU 图扩展，同时\n"
+"      保持 FlashComm1 禁用以及静态/超级内核禁用。\n"
+"    - MTP 投机解码在 A2 系列上使用三个投机 token。\n"
+"      Prefill 使用 `enforce_eager: true`；Decode 使用 `enforce_eager: false`\n"
+"      并采用 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 图模式。\n"
+"    - Decode 上的 `HCCL_HOST_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE` 和 `HCCL_NPU_SOCKET_PORT_RANGE`\n"
+"      为每个 DP rank 预留一个互不重叠的 100 端口窗口（从\n"
+"      `60000 + rank * 100` 开始）。当多个引擎共享一个节点时，这些\n"
+"      范围可防止 HCCL 主机侧套接字在不同 rank 之间静默共享\n"
+"      端口，从而避免阻塞引擎启动。\n"
+"    - 其余超时和运行时变量\n"
+"      （`VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS`、`HCCL_EXEC_TIMEOUT`、\n"
+"      `HCCL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`、`VLLM_RPC_TIMEOUT`、`OMP_PROC_BIND`、\n"
+"      `OMP_NUM_THREADS`）是针对此模型大小经过验证的 A2 系列启动默认值；\n"
+"      除非你的环境需要不同的值，否则请保持这些设置。\n"
+"    - `HCCL_IF_IP` 和所有套接字接口变量必须选择\n"
+"      配置的节点 IP 所使用的服务网络。DP RPC、\n"
+"      引擎、Mooncake 和代理端口必须被主机\n"
+"      防火墙允许。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This section uses MemCache as the AscendStoreConnector backend for KV Cache Pooling.\n"

+"MemCache provides the shared pool. Select the platform subsection that matches the\n"
+"PD topology in [Section 5.3](#53-1p1d-pd-disaggregated-deployment).\n"
+"`MultiConnector` combines two connectors:"

+"在 A2 系列上，MooncakeConnectorV2 仍然是 Prefill 到 Decode 的 KV 传输连接器；\n"
+"MemCache 提供共享池。请选择与\n"
+"[第 5.3 节](#53-1p1d-pd-disaggregated-deployment)中 PD 拓扑相匹配的平台子节。\n"

+
+msgid ""

+"    两个角色都使用 EP8、FP8 主 KV cache 和 FP8 索引器。\n"

+"    `--limit-mm-per-prompt '{\"image\": 1, \"video\": 0}'` 以及显式\n"
+"    `--enable-chunked-prefill`。Prefill 使用\n"
+"    `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=3072`、`--max-num-seqs 256`、\n"
+"    `--max-num-batched-tokens 24576`、`--gpu-memory-utilization 0.9` 和\n"
+"    `multistream_overlap_shared_expert: true`。Decode 使用\n"
+"    `--max-num-seqs 30`、`--max-num-batched-tokens 120`、\n"

+msgid ""
+"This KV Cache Pool example uses DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill and DP8/TP2 Decode,\n"
+"    using Model Runner V2 and native KDA. Prepare separate `run_p.sh` and\n"

+"    sequences and 240 batched tokens. Both roles limit image input to one image.\n"

+"    Add the Memcache environment settings and replace the connectors as\n"
+"    described below. Reuse the ordinary PD launch commands and proxy mapping."
+msgstr ""
+"本 KV Cache Pool 示例使用 DP2/TP1/PCP8 Prefill 和 DP8/TP2 Decode，\n"
+"    采用 Model Runner V2 和原生 KDA。请基于 [A3 PD 脚本](#glm53-flash-5-3-a3)\n"
+"    为此场景准备单独的 `run_p.sh` 和 `run_d.sh` 文件。\n"
+"    在两个角色上保留常规 PD 服务参数，包括\n"

+"    Prefill 使用 32 个序列和 16384 个批处理 token；Decode 使用 40\n"
+"    个序列和 240 个批处理 token。两个角色均将图像输入限制为一张图像。\n"
+"    为此池化示例添加 `--enable-prefix-caching`。\n"

+
+msgid ""
+"Use the common A2 Prefill/Decode templates and PCP-aware launcher from\n"
+"    [Section 5.3](#glm53-flash-5-3-a2) as the baseline. This subsection gives\n"
+"    only the pool-specific configuration; it does not repeat the serving or\n"
+"    proxy scripts. Keep the Section 5.3 model parameters, including prefix\n"
+"    caching and MTP with three speculative tokens."
+msgstr ""
+"以 [第 5.3 节](#glm53-flash-5-3-a2) 中的通用 A2 Prefill/Decode 模板和\n"

+"    代理脚本。保留第 5.3 节的模型参数，包括前缀\n"
+"    缓存和带三个推测 token 的 MTP。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The pool topology is Prefill DP2/TP1/PCP8 and Decode DP8/TP2/PCP1.\n"
+"    P0 and P1 both expose Prefill APIs in this pool deployment. In the common\n"
+"    Prefill template from Section 5.3, keep the launcher-supplied DP arguments\n"
+"    and add the external DP rank argument:\n"
+"    `--data-parallel-rank \"$4\"`. Keep P0's `--api-server-count 1`."
+msgstr ""
+"池化拓扑为 Prefill DP2/TP1/PCP8 和 Decode DP8/TP2/PCP1。\n"
+"    在此池化部署中，P0 和 P1 均对外提供 Prefill API。在第 5.3 节的通用\n"
+"    Prefill 模板中，保留启动器提供的 DP 参数，\n"
+"    并添加外部 DP rank 参数：\n"
+"    `--data-parallel-rank \"$4\"`。保留 P0 的 `--api-server-count 1`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In P1's `run_p1.sh` wrapper from Section 5.3, replace\n"
+"    `export SERVER_ROLE_ARGS=\"--headless --data-parallel-start-rank 1\"` with\n"
+"    `export SERVER_ROLE_ARGS=\"--api-server-count 1\"`. The common `run_p.sh`\n"

+msgstr ""
+"在第 5.3 节中 P1 的 `run_p1.sh` 包装脚本中，将\n"
+"    `export SERVER_ROLE_ARGS=\"--headless --data-parallel-start-rank 1\"` 替换为\n"

+msgid "Configure the pool proxy for both Prefill APIs and all Decode APIs:"

+msgstr ""
+"保留 `MooncakeConnectorV2` 用于 Prefill 到 Decode 的 KV 传输，并为共享池\n"
+"    配置使用 MemCache 后端的 `AscendStoreConnector`。"

+msgid "##### Prepare MemCache"
+msgstr "##### 准备 MemCache"
+
+msgid ""
+"Follow the [MemCache backend setup](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-backend) for prerequisites and installation. For A2, check the guide's [HDK/CANN compatibility reference](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#hdk-and-cann-version-compatibility-reference): HDK 25.5 or later is recommended and CANN 9.1.0 or later is required.\n"
+"    Confirm `/etc/hccn.conf` is visible inside every engine container (mount the host file when needed), and that the Section 5.3 `LOCAL_IP` and `NIC_NAME` match the A2 RoCE interface. This A2 setup uses `device_rdma`; A3 HCCS-specific `device_sdma` and FabricMem settings belong in the A3 instructions. Install `memfabric-hybrid>=1.3.0` and `memcache-hybrid>=1.3.0`. All nodes must reach the same MetaService."
+msgstr ""
+"请按照 [MemCache 后端设置](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-backend) 完成前置条件和安装。对于 A2，请查看指南中的 [HDK/CANN 兼容性参考](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#hdk-and-cann-version-compatibility-reference)：建议使用 HDK 25.5 或更高版本，且要求 CANN 9.1.0 或更高版本。\n"
+"    确认 `/etc/hccn.conf` 在每个引擎容器内可见（必要时挂载宿主机文件），并确认第 5.3 节的 `LOCAL_IP` 和 `NIC_NAME` 与 A2 RoCE 接口匹配。此 A2 设置使用 `device_rdma`；A3 HCCS 专用的 `device_sdma` 和 FabricMem 设置属于 A3 说明。安装 `memfabric-hybrid>=1.3.0` 和 `memcache-hybrid>=1.3.0`。所有节点必须能访问同一个 MetaService。"
+
+msgid "Prepare `mmc-meta.conf` on the MetaService host:"
+msgstr "在 MetaService 主机上准备 `mmc-meta.conf`："
+
+msgid ""
+"Prepare `mmc-local.conf` in shared storage or place an identical copy on\n"
+"    every Prefill and Decode node. Keep its MetaService endpoints identical to\n"
+"    `mmc-meta.conf`. `device_rdma` is the A2 RoCE protocol. `dram.size` is the\n"
+"    allocation per LocalService; non-zero `device_*` allocations are aligned\n"
+"    to 1GB. `40GB` is an example only. Check available host memory with\n"
+"    `free -h`, reserve headroom for the OS and vLLM, and size the pool for the\n"
+"    workload."
+msgstr ""
+"在共享存储中准备 `mmc-local.conf`，或在\n"
+"    每个 Prefill 和 Decode 节点上放置完全相同的副本。保持其 MetaService 端点与\n"
+"    `mmc-meta.conf` 一致。`device_rdma` 是 A2 RoCE 协议。`dram.size` 是\n"
+"    每个 LocalService 的分配量；非零的 `device_*` 分配量会按\n"
+"    1GB 对齐。`40GB` 仅为示例。使用\n"
+"    `free -h` 检查宿主机可用内存，为操作系统和 vLLM 预留余量，并根据\n"
+"    工作负载确定池大小。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In this topology, each host runs eight model-parallel workers when all\n"
+"    configured devices are used: one Prefill rank with PCP8, or four Decode\n"
+"    ranks with TP2. Each worker initializes a LocalService, so estimate each\n"
+"    host's DRAM contribution as eight times `dram.size`; use the actual worker\n"
+"    count if it differs. `world_size` is the maximum supported number of\n"
+"    LocalServices, not a DP-rank count. Keep it consistent and large enough\n"
+"    across the deployment; changing it after ranks connect requires restarting\n"
+"    MetaService."
+msgstr ""
+"在此拓扑中，当使用所有已配置设备时，每台主机运行八个模型并行 worker：\n"
+"    一个使用 PCP8 的 Prefill rank，或四个使用 TP2 的 Decode\n"
+"    rank。每个 worker 都会初始化一个 LocalService，因此请将每台\n"
+"    主机的 DRAM 占用估算为 `dram.size` 的八倍；如果实际 worker\n"
+"    数量不同，请使用实际数量。`world_size` 是支持的最大\n"
+"    LocalService 数量，而不是 DP rank 数量。在整个部署中保持其一致且足够大；\n"
+"    在 rank 连接后更改它需要重启\n"
+"    MetaService。"
+
+msgid ""
+"This configuration pools DRAM only; SSD device parameters are not needed."
+msgstr "此配置仅池化 DRAM；不需要 SSD 设备参数。"
+
+msgid ""
+"On every engine node, use the same MemCache installation/configuration\n"
+"    paths and add these pool-related settings to the existing Section 5.3\n"
+"    wrappers. Use `pip show memcache_hybrid` to find its `Location`; set\n"
+"    `MEMCACHE_ROOT` to `<Location>/memcache_hybrid`. Set `PYTHON_LIB_DIR` to\n"
+"    Python's `LIBDIR` (from `sysconfig`). Keep `PYTHONHASHSEED` and the\n"
+"    `MMC_LOCAL_CONFIG_PATH` consistent across nodes. Keep Section 5.3's A2\n"
+"    RoCE exports, including `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1` and the HCCL/GLOO/TP\n"
+"    socket interface settings, as well as the existing `LOCAL_IP`, `NIC_NAME`,\n"
+"    and `MODEL_PATH` wrapper settings."
+msgstr ""
+"在每个引擎节点上，使用相同的 MemCache 安装/配置\n"
+"    路径，并将这些池化相关设置添加到现有的第 5.3 节\n"
+"    包装脚本中。使用 `pip show memcache_hybrid` 查找其 `Location`；将\n"
+"    `MEMCACHE_ROOT` 设置为 `<Location>/memcache_hybrid`。将 `PYTHON_LIB_DIR` 设置为\n"
+"    Python 的 `LIBDIR`（来自 `sysconfig`）。在各节点间保持 `PYTHONHASHSEED` 和\n"
+"    `MMC_LOCAL_CONFIG_PATH` 一致。保留第 5.3 节的 A2\n"
+"    RoCE 导出项，包括 `HCCL_INTRA_ROCE_ENABLE=1` 以及 HCCL/GLOO/TP\n"
+"    套接字接口设置，同时保留现有的 `LOCAL_IP`、`NIC_NAME`\n"
+"    和 `MODEL_PATH` 包装脚本设置。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`ACL_OP_INIT_MODE=1` selects ACL operator initialization mode to speed up "
+"operator compilation."
+msgstr "`ACL_OP_INIT_MODE=1` 选择 ACL 算子初始化模式，以加速算子编译。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start MetaService before the vLLM engines using Step 4 in the\n"
+"    [MemCache backend guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-backend).\n"
+"    Set `MMC_META_CONFIG_PATH` on the MetaService host to the configured\n"
+"    `mmc-meta.conf` file."
+msgstr ""
+"使用 [MemCache 后端指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-backend) 中的第 4 步，在 vLLM 引擎之前启动 MetaService。\n"
+"    将 MetaService 主机上的 `MMC_META_CONFIG_PATH` 设置为已配置的\n"
+"    `mmc-meta.conf` 文件。"
+
+msgid "##### Configure the KV connectors"
+msgstr "##### 配置 KV 连接器"
+
+msgid ""
+"In the existing Prefill script from Section 5.3, replace only its\n"
+"    `--kv-transfer-config` value with this fragment. `$4` is the DP rank\n"
+"    supplied by `launch_online_dp.py`; it keeps each Prefill engine ID unique."
+msgstr ""
+"在 5.3 节中已有的 Prefill 脚本中，仅将其\n"
+"    `--kv-transfer-config` 值替换为此片段。`$4` 是由 `launch_online_dp.py`\n"
+"    提供的 DP rank；它可确保每个 Prefill 引擎 ID 唯一。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In the existing Decode script from Section 5.3, replace only its\n"
+"    `--kv-transfer-config` value. Decode engine IDs use `100 +` the launcher\n"
+"    DP rank to remain unique across the pool."
+msgstr ""
+"在 5.3 节中已有的 Decode 脚本中，仅替换其\n"
+"    `--kv-transfer-config` 值。Decode 引擎 ID 使用 `100 +` 启动器\n"
+"    DP rank，以在整个池中保持唯一。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`launch_online_dp.py` starts each DP rank in a separate engine process, so set\n"
+"    `lookup_rpc_port` uniquely for every P/D engine: `37000 + $4` on Prefill and\n"
+"    `37100 + $4` on Decode, where `$4` is the launcher-supplied DP rank. This\n"
+"    value identifies a local IPC endpoint; it is not a TCP listening port. Also\n"
+"    check Mooncake worker and scheduler TCP port ranges for conflicts with other\n"
+"    listeners."
+msgstr ""
+"`launch_online_dp.py` 会在单独的引擎进程中启动每个 DP rank，因此请为每个 P/D 引擎\n"
+"    唯一设置 `lookup_rpc_port`：Prefill 上为 `37000 + $4`，\n"
+"    Decode 上为 `37100 + $4`，其中 `$4` 是启动器提供的 DP rank。该\n"
+"    值标识本地 IPC 端点；它不是 TCP 监听端口。另请\n"
+"    检查 Mooncake worker 和 scheduler 的 TCP 端口范围是否与其他\n"
+"    监听器冲突。"
+
+msgid "##### Start and verify the pool"
+msgstr "##### 启动并验证池"
+
+msgid ""
+"Start the services in this order: MetaService, Decode, Prefill, then the\n"
+"    pool proxy. Start MetaService using Step 4 in the\n"
+"    [MemCache backend guide](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-backend),\n"
+"    with `MMC_META_CONFIG_PATH` pointing to `mmc-meta.conf`. Ensure the configured\n"
+"    MetaService ports 5000/6000 and metrics port 8009 are reachable from all\n"
+"    engine nodes."
+msgstr ""
+"按以下顺序启动服务：MetaService、Decode、Prefill，然后是\n"
+"    池代理。使用\n"
+"    [MemCache 后端指南](../../user_guide/feature_guide/kv_cache_pool_ascend_store.md#scenario-2-memcache-backend) 中的第 4 步启动 MetaService，\n"
+"    并将 `MMC_META_CONFIG_PATH` 指向 `mmc-meta.conf`。确保所有\n"
+"    引擎节点均可访问已配置的\n"
+"    MetaService 端口 5000/6000 和指标端口 8009。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use the Section 5.3 launcher commands for D0/D1, then P0/P1 with the pool\n"
+"    role settings above. Wait for all eight Decode APIs on ports 8000-8003 and\n"
+"    both Prefill APIs on port 8000 to become ready, and confirm the MemCache\n"
+"    LocalServices initialize before starting the existing proxy on port 28000.\n"
+"    Route it to both Prefill endpoints and all eight Decode endpoints, then\n"
+"    send the functional-verification requests from Section 6."
+msgstr ""
+"对 D0/D1 使用 5.3 节的启动器命令，然后使用上述池\n"
+"    角色设置对 P0/P1 执行相同操作。等待端口 8000-8003 上的全部八个 Decode API\n"
+"    以及端口 8000 上的两个 Prefill API 就绪，并在启动端口 28000 上的现有代理之前\n"
+"    确认 MemCache LocalServices 已初始化。\n"
+"    将其路由到两个 Prefill 端点和全部八个 Decode 端点，然后\n"
+"    发送第 6 节中的功能验证请求。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Warm the pool with a prompt longer than one cache block, then repeat the\n"
+"    same prefix on a different Prefill rank. Check both Prefill launch logs for\n"
+"    pool saves, lookups, loads, and cache hits, and Decode logs for successful\n"
+"    Prefill-to-Decode transfers. Compare\n"
+"    `vllm:ascend_store_load_get_keys_total` at the Prefill API metrics endpoints\n"
+"    before and after the cross-rank repeat; a local prefix-cache hit alone does\n"
+"    not demonstrate shared-pool reuse. Only complete cache blocks are reused."
+msgstr ""
+"使用长于一个缓存块的提示词预热池，然后在不同的 Prefill rank 上重复\n"
+"    相同的前缀。检查两个 Prefill 启动日志中的\n"
+"    池保存、查找、加载和缓存命中情况，以及 Decode 日志中成功的\n"
+"    Prefill 到 Decode 传输。在跨 rank 重复前后，比较 Prefill API 指标端点上的\n"
+"    `vllm:ascend_store_load_get_keys_total`；仅本地前缀缓存命中\n"
+"    并不能证明共享池复用。仅完整的缓存块会被复用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Keep the Section 5.3 serving settings except for the pool-specific P1 API\n"
+"    role, API endpoint mapping above, and the connector configuration here."
+msgstr ""
+"保留 5.3 节的服务设置，但池专用的 P1 API\n"
+"    角色、上述 API 端点映射以及此处的连接器配置除外。"
+
+msgid ""
+"| MTP | Prefill and Decode | `num_speculative_tokens: 3` | Uses draft graph "
+"execution on both roles; the Prefill target is eager. |"
+msgstr ""
+"| MTP | Prefill 和 Decode | `num_speculative_tokens: 3` | 在两种角色上均使用 draft "
+"图执行；Prefill 目标为 eager 模式。 |"

+msgid ""
+"`--long-prefill-token-threshold 8192` sets the long-prefill threshold used "
+"with chunked prefill. The scheduler uses this threshold to limit the prefill"
+" tokens scheduled for a long request in one iteration, while `--max-num-"
+"batched-tokens 8192` bounds the total token budget for the iteration. In "
+"this single-request example both values are 8192, so the 1M prompt is "
+"processed in chunks within that budget. This parameter does not reduce the "
+"total context limit configured by `--max-model-len`. See the [vLLM scheduler"
+" arguments](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/configuration/engine_args/#-long-"
+"prefill-token-threshold) for details."
+msgstr ""
+"`--long-prefill-token-threshold 8192` "
+"设置与分块预填充配合使用的长预填充阈值。调度器使用该阈值限制单次迭代中为长请求调度的预填充 token 数，而 `--max-num-batched-"
+"tokens 8192` 限制该次迭代的总 token 预算。在此单请求示例中，两个值均为 8192，因此 1M "
+"的提示词会在该预算内分块处理。此参数不会降低由 `--max-model-len` 配置的总上下文限制。详情请参阅 [vLLM "

+msgid "**Key parameters:**"
+msgstr "**关键参数：**"
+
+msgid ""
+"- `--tensor-parallel-size`: number of NPU chips the model is sharded across. Choose a value that divides the attention head count of the chosen model size.\n"
+"- `--max-model-len`: maximum sequence length (prompt plus generated tokens). Larger values allocate more KV cache memory and attention workspace; lower it if the service reports OOM at startup.\n"
+"- `--max-num-batched-tokens`: maximum number of tokens processed in one scheduler step. Larger values improve prefill throughput at the cost of first-token latency.\n"
+"- `--max-num-seqs`: maximum number of concurrently running sequences; it bounds KV cache and graph capture pressure.\n"
+"- `--compilation-config`: ACLGraph settings. `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` enables graph replay for the decode phase, and `cudagraph_capture_sizes` lists the batch sizes captured at startup, so it should cover your expected concurrency.\n"
+"- `--gpu-memory-utilization`: fraction of NPU memory reserved for the KV cache; reduce it when startup or runtime requests report OOM.\n"
+"- `--quantization ascend`: required for the W8A8/W4A4/W8A8SC weights listed in Section 3.1; remove it when serving BF16 weights.\n"
+"- `--distributed-executor-backend \"mp\"`: uses multi-process execution for multi-card tensor parallelism."
+msgstr ""
+"- `--tensor-parallel-size`：模型分片所跨的 NPU 芯片数量。请选择一个能整除所选模型规模注意力头数的值。\n"
+"- `--max-model-len`：最大序列长度（提示词加上生成的 token）。值越大，分配的 KV cache 内存和注意力工作区越多；如果服务在启动时报告 OOM，请调低该值。\n"
+"- `--max-num-batched-tokens`：单个调度步骤中处理的最大 token 数。值越大，prefill 吞吐越高，但首 token 延迟会增加。\n"
+"- `--max-num-seqs`：并发运行的序列最大数量；它限制了 KV cache 和图捕获的压力。\n"
+"- `--compilation-config`：ACLGraph 设置。`FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 为 decode 阶段启用图重放，`cudagraph_capture_sizes` 列出启动时捕获的批大小，因此应覆盖您预期的并发量。\n"
+"- `--gpu-memory-utilization`：为 KV cache 预留的 NPU 内存比例；当启动或运行时请求报告 OOM 时，请调低该值。\n"
+"- `--quantization ascend`：3.1 节中列出的 W8A8/W4A4/W8A8SC 权重需要此参数；服务 BF16 权重时请移除该参数。\n"
+"- `--distributed-executor-backend \"mp\"`：使用多进程执行来实现多卡张量并行。"
+

+msgid ""
+"- TP4 × DP1 uses devices 0–3 and a W4A8-MXFP checkpoint. NPU graph extension"
+" and static kernels are enabled; super kernels are disabled."
+msgstr "- TP4 × DP1 使用设备 0–3 和 W4A8-MXFP 检查点。NPU 图扩展和静态内核已启用；超级内核已禁用。"
+
+msgid ""
+"For 950DT products, basic PD, the image-and-text 10K case, and the long-"
+"context case use the same Docker container setup from [Section "
+"4.1](#41-docker-image-installation), under the `950DT products` tab."
+msgstr ""
+"对于 Ascend 950DT系列产品，基础 PD、图文 10K 用例和长上下文用例使用 [第 4.1 节](#41-docker-image-"
+"installation) 中相同的 Docker 容器设置，位于 `950DT products` 标签页下。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Prefill uses TP4 × PP2 × DP1 in eager mode, with `enable_prefill_mc2=true` and fused MC2 disabled. Check MC2 token limits before increasing the batch budget.\n"
+"- Decode uses TP2 × DP4, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, NPU graph extension, static kernels, and recompute scheduling; super kernels are disabled.\n"
+"- Both roles use three MTP draft tokens, with `enforce_eager=true` on P and `false` on D. Batch tokens are 8192; P/D HCCL buffers are 8192/512.\n"
+"- Engram CPU offload requires supported n-gram layers and sufficient host memory. P uses `dp_shared_memory=false`; D uses `true`. Shared-memory DP replicas must share a host and shared-memory namespace.\n"
+"- Both roles set prefix caching, Mamba cache mode `align`, and Mamba state dtype `bfloat16`. Keep Mooncake TP/PP/DP declarations consistent with the model commands; clear `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` to use the default partition.\n"
+"- Prefill sets `enable_fused_mc2=0` while enabling shared expert overlap."
+msgstr ""
+"- Prefill 在 eager 模式下使用 TP4 × PP2 × DP1，设置 `enable_prefill_mc2=true` 并禁用融合 MC2。在增加批处理预算之前请检查 MC2 token 限制。\n"
+"- Decode 使用 TP2 × DP4、`FULL_DECODE_ONLY`、NPU 图扩展、静态内核和重计算调度；超级内核已禁用。\n"
+"- 两个角色均使用三个 MTP 草稿 token，P 上设置 `enforce_eager=true`，D 上设置为 `false`。批处理 token 为 8192；P/D HCCL 缓冲区为 8192/512。\n"
+"- Engram CPU 卸载需要受支持的 n-gram 层和足够的主机内存。P 使用 `dp_shared_memory=false`；D 使用 `true`。共享内存 DP 副本必须共享同一主机和共享内存命名空间。\n"
+"- 两个角色均设置前缀缓存、Mamba 缓存模式 `align` 和 Mamba 状态数据类型 `bfloat16`。保持 Mooncake TP/PP/DP 声明与模型命令一致；清除 `VLLM_PP_LAYER_PARTITION` 以使用默认分区。\n"
+"- Prefill 设置 `enable_fused_mc2=0`，同时启用共享专家重叠。"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Each command starts TP2 × DP2 on four devices. `--api-server-count 1` exposes one API endpoint per role; use distinct DP RPC ports for Prefill and Decode.\n"
+"- Model Runner V2, async scheduling, and expert parallelism are enabled.\n"
+"- Engram uses CPU offload and DP shared memory. DP replicas must share the same host and shared-memory namespace.\n"
+"- Prefill enables prefix caching and uses `cudagraph_mode=NONE`; static kernels are disabled.\n"
+"- Decode enables prefix caching, `FULL_DECODE_ONLY`, static kernels, and recompute scheduling; MTP sets `enforce_eager=false` to allow graph execution.\n"
+"- Both roles enable CPU binding, shared expert DP, FlashComm1, shared expert multistream overlap, and NPU graph extension. Fused MC2, norm/quantization fusion, and super kernels are disabled.\n"
+"- Both roles use three MTP draft tokens and `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=4800` for engine startup; model execution uses `VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3000`.\n"
+"- Both roles use `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=8192` and `ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL=0:0`. The validated configuration separates Prefill and Decode HCCL base ports (62000/63000) and NPU socket ranges (61400–61499/61500–61599).\n"
+"- Keep Mooncake DP2/TP2 declarations consistent with the services. The proxy connects to Prefill on port 8088 and Decode on port 8092. Keep the configured KV base ports at 30000 and 30100; the connector applies rank offsets internally."
+msgstr ""
+"- 每个命令在四个设备上启动 TP2 × DP2。`--api-server-count 1` 为每个角色暴露一个 API 端点；请为 Prefill 和 Decode 使用不同的 DP RPC 端口。\n"
+"- Model Runner V2、异步调度和专家并行已启用。\n"
+"- Engram 使用 CPU 卸载和 DP 共享内存。DP 副本必须共享同一主机和共享内存命名空间。\n"
+"- Prefill 启用前缀缓存并使用 `cudagraph_mode=NONE`；静态内核已禁用。\n"
+"- Decode 启用前缀缓存、`FULL_DECODE_ONLY`、静态内核和重计算调度；MTP 设置 `enforce_eager=false` 以允许图执行。\n"
+"- 两个角色均启用 CPU 绑定、共享专家 DP、FlashComm1、共享专家多流重叠和 NPU 图扩展。融合 MC2、归一化/量化融合和超级内核已禁用。\n"
+"- 两个角色均使用三个 MTP 草稿 token 和 `VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=4800` 用于引擎启动；模型执行使用 `VLLM_EXECUTE_MODEL_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=3000`。\n"
+"- 两个角色均使用 `HCCL_BUFFSIZE=8192` 和 `ASCEND_BUFFER_POOL=0:0`。经验证的配置将 Prefill 和 Decode 的 HCCL 基础端口分开（62000/63000），NPU socket 范围分开（61400–61499/61500–61599）。\n"
+"- 保持 Mooncake DP2/TP2 声明与服务一致。代理连接到 Prefill 的 8088 端口和 Decode 的 8092 端口。保持配置的 KV 基础端口为 30000 和 30100；连接器会在内部应用 rank 偏移。"
+
+msgid "### 5.4 Long-Context PD Separation Deployment"
+msgstr "### 5.4 长上下文 PD 分离部署"
+
+msgid ""
+"This case uses eight devices on one 950DT products host, with TP4 × DP1 for "
+"both Prefill and Decode. Both roles set the maximum combined input and "
+"output length to 1,010,000 tokens, with up to 16 active sequences and 4096 "
+"batch tokens. Initialize the environment as described in [Section "
+"4](#4-installation) and run each role in a separate terminal."
+msgstr ""
+"本用例在一台 Ascend 950DT系列产品主机上使用八个设备，Prefill 和 Decode 均使用 TP4 × "
+"DP1。两个角色均将最大输入和输出总长度设置为 1,010,000 个 token，最多支持 16 个活动序列和 4096 个批处理 token。按照 "
+"[第 4 节](#4-installation) 的说明初始化环境，并在单独的终端中运行每个角色。"
+
+msgid "!!! note \"Extending the native 256K context to approximately 1M\""
+msgstr "!!! note \"将原生 256K 上下文扩展到约 1M\""
+
+msgid ""
+"The checkpoint's native context window is 256K (262144 tokens). This long-"
+"context case requires all three settings on **both Prefill and Decode**: the"
+" complete YaRN `--hf-overrides` shown below, with `factor=4.0` and "
+"`original_max_position_embeddings=262144`; `export "
+"VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1`; and `--max-model-len 1010000`. Keep the "
+"YaRN configuration and maximum model length identical on both roles; none of"
+" these three settings can be omitted."
+msgstr ""
+"检查点的原生上下文窗口为 256K（262144 个 token）。本长上下文用例需要在 **Prefill 和 Decode 两者** "
+"上设置全部三项配置：如下所示的完整 YaRN `--hf-overrides`，其中 `factor=4.0` 且 "
+"`original_max_position_embeddings=262144`；`export "
+"VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1`；以及 `--max-model-len 1010000`。请保持两个角色上的 YaRN"
+" 配置和最大模型长度一致；这三项设置均不可省略。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Each request must satisfy `input token count + maximum output token count <="
+" max-model-len`. With this configuration, the total must not exceed "

+msgid "## GDN internal prefill checkpoints"
+msgstr "## GDN 内部 prefill 检查点"
+
+msgid ""
+"Enable with `--additional-config '{\"gdn_internal_prefill_checkpoints\": true}'`.\n"
+"The option remains disabled by default pending numerical and performance\n"
+"qualification of the alternate prefill recurrence on supported NPUs.\n"
+"Requires prefix caching in align mode and vLLM with #60050. The optimization is\n"
+"experimental. Eligible GDN layers require BF16,\n"
+"K=V=128, PCP=1 and no ubatching. The upstream all-layer capability check preserves split\n"
+"prefill when another recurrent layer cannot export checkpoints.\n"
+"KV transfer configurations and legacy EAGLE/MTP block dropping without\n"
+"lookahead hashes fall back to existing prefill scheduling: the scheduler and\n"
+"worker cannot safely assume the same internal checkpoint boundary in these modes."
+msgstr ""
+"通过 `--additional-config '{\"gdn_internal_prefill_checkpoints\": true}'` 启用。\n"
+"在受支持的 NPU 上，替代的 prefill 递推实现尚未通过数值和性能验证，因此该选项默认保持禁用。\n"
+"需要 align 模式下的前缀缓存，以及包含 #60050 的 vLLM。该优化为实验性功能。符合条件的 GDN 层要求 BF16、\n"
+"K=V=128、PCP=1 且不使用 ubatching。上游的全层能力检查会在另一个递推层无法导出检查点时保留拆分\n"
+"prefill。\n"
+"KV 传输配置以及不带\n"
+"lookahead 哈希的旧版 EAGLE/MTP 块丢弃会回退到现有的 prefill 调度：在这些模式下，调度器和\n"
+"worker 无法安全地假定相同的内部检查点边界。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Checkpoint-bearing prefill uses the existing Triton recurrence instead of the\n"
+"AscendC FwdH implementation to export only selected FP32 chunk-start states.\n"
+"Convolution history and recurrent state are written through the shared upstream\n"
+"checkpoint exporter. Enabled layers use the same Triton recurrence for cold\n"
+"prefills and cache-hit tails, including tails without a new checkpoint. At an\n"
+"exported boundary, the cold FP32 accumulator is rounded to the configured SSM\n"
+"cache dtype before continuing, matching the state restored by a cache hit.\n"
+"Decode is unchanged. This backend change needs numerical\n"
+"and performance qualification; skipping a model forward does not guarantee a\n"
+"net speedup. A persistent FP32 scratch buffer is allocated during profiling, of size\n"
+"`max_num_seqs * local_value_heads * 128 * 128 * 4` bytes. Eligible layers\n"
+"with the same VllmConfig, device and state shape share it; ubatching is excluded.\n"
+"Checkpoint export retains a view of the pre-convolution input; the pinned FLA\n"
+"convolution allocates its output separately.\n"
+"Small prefix match units can increase checkpoint traffic."
+msgstr ""
+"带检查点的 prefill 使用现有的 Triton 递推实现而非\n"
+"AscendC FwdH 实现，以仅导出选定的 FP32 chunk 起始状态。\n"
+"卷积历史和递推状态通过共享的上游\n"
+"检查点导出器写入。启用的层对冷\n"
+"prefill 和缓存命中尾部（包括没有新检查点的尾部）使用相同的 Triton 递推实现。在\n"
+"导出的边界处，冷 FP32 累加器会先舍入到配置的 SSM\n"
+"缓存 dtype 再继续，以与缓存命中恢复的状态保持一致。\n"
+"Decode 保持不变。此后端变更需要数值\n"
+"和性能验证；跳过一次模型前向并不保证\n"
+"净加速。在 profiling 期间会分配一个持久的 FP32 暂存缓冲区，大小为\n"
+"`max_num_seqs * local_value_heads * 128 * 128 * 4` 字节。具有相同 VllmConfig、设备和状态形状的\n"
+"符合条件的层共享该缓冲区；不包括 ubatching。\n"
+"检查点导出会保留卷积前输入的视图；固定版本的 FLA\n"
+"卷积会单独分配其输出。\n"
+"较小的前缀匹配单元会增加检查点流量。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Validate correctness, quality and performance on the deployment hardware "
+"before deploying in production."
+msgstr "在生产环境部署前，请在部署硬件上验证正确性、质量和性能。"

+msgid "!!! warning \"Deprecation Notice for GQA Models\""
+msgstr "!!! warning \"GQA 模型弃用通知\""
+
+msgid ""
+"Decode Context Parallelism (DCP) for **GQA models** is **deprecated** as of "
+"v0.32.0 and has entered the sunset process (will be removed in a future "
+"release). GQA models naturally shard KV heads across TP ranks, and in "
+"speculative decoding, GQA draft models maintain native TP sharding under "
+"target DCP. Maintaining dedicated GQA DCP metadata and communication paths "
+"is no longer justified. Note that DCP for **MLA and SFA models** remains "
+"fully supported and recommended. For more details, see [RFC "
+"#21305](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/21305)."
+msgstr ""
+"自 v0.32.0 起，针对 **GQA 模型** 的 Decode Context "
+"Parallelism（DCP）已**弃用**，并已进入淘汰流程（将在未来版本中移除）。GQA 模型天然会在 TP rank 之间分片 KV "
+"head，而在投机解码中，GQA draft 模型在目标 DCP 下仍保持原生 TP 分片。因此，已无必要维护专用的 GQA DCP "
+"元数据和通信路径。请注意，针对 **MLA 和 SFA 模型** 的 DCP 仍完全受支持并推荐使用。更多详情请参见 [RFC "
+"#21305](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/21305)。"

+msgid "!!! warning \"Sunset and Deprecation Notice\""
+msgstr "!!! warning \"日落与弃用通知\""
+
+msgid ""
+"Dynamic Chunked Pipeline Parallel (CPP) with dynamic chunk size is "
+"**deprecated** as of v0.32.0 and has entered the sunset process. It will be "
+"removed in a future release. With the architectural evolution towards sparse"
+" (MoE/SFA) and linear attention models, dynamic chunking offers negligible "
+"performance benefit while adding significant scheduling complexity and "
+"profiling overhead. Users are advised to use static chunked prefill or "
+"Prefill Context Parallelism (PCP). For more details, see [RFC "
+"#21304](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/21304)."
+msgstr ""
+"自 v0.32.0 起，采用动态 chunk 大小的动态分块流水线并行（Dynamic Chunked Pipeline "
+"Parallel，CPP）已被**弃用**，并已进入日落流程，将在未来版本中移除。随着架构向稀疏（MoE/SFA）和线性注意力模型演进，动态分块带来的性能收益微乎其微，同时却显著增加了调度复杂度和性能分析开销。建议用户改用静态分块预填充（static"
+" chunked prefill）或预填充上下文并行（Prefill Context Parallelism，PCP）。更多详情请参阅 [RFC "
+"#21304](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/issues/21304)。"

-msgid ""
-"Stage selection applies to dynamic EPLB heat collection. Internally, vLLM-"
-"Ascend classifies each forward iteration by comparing its padded scheduled "
-"token count with the maximum expected token count of a decode iteration. An "
-"iteration above the threshold is treated as prefill; an iteration at or "
-"below the threshold is treated as decode. Classification is therefore "
-"performed per forward iteration rather than per individual request."

-"数进行比较来对迭代进行分类。高于阈值的迭代被视为 prefill；等于或低于阈值的迭代被视为 "
-"decode。因此，分类是按每次前向迭代执行的，而不是按单个请求执行的。"

+"配置。原有的 `VLLM_PREFIX_CACHE_RETENTION_INTERVAL` 环境变量\n"

+msgid ""

+"如需迁移原本设定的间隔 `4096`，请在之前导出该环境变量的\n"
+"相同实例上传入 `--prefix-cache-retention-interval 4096`。"

+msgid "### Weight checker"
+msgstr "### 权重校验器"
+
+msgid ""
+"The Weight Checker helps validate the weight-transfer path during development.\n"
+"It computes SHA-256 digests for model parameters on each rank, resets the\n"
+"parameters, and checks whether transferring the original weights back restores\n"
+"the same digests. See the upstream\n"
+"[Weight Checker guide](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/training/weight_checker/)\n"
+"for the full API."
+msgstr ""
+"权重校验器用于在开发过程中验证权重传输路径。它会在每个 rank 上计算模型参数的 SHA-256 摘要，重置参数，并检查将原始权重传回后是否能恢复相同的摘要。完整 API 请参阅上游的\n"
+"[Weight Checker 指南](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/training/weight_checker/)。"
+
+msgid "All three operations use `POST /weight_checker`:"
+msgstr "这三个操作均使用 `POST /weight_checker`："
+
+msgid "| Action | Purpose | Request body | Response |"
+msgstr "| 操作 | 用途 | 请求体 | 响应 |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `checksum` | Compute the current digest of each checked parameter without "
+"changing it. Save the result as the baseline before resetting weights. | "
+"`{\"action\":\"checksum\"}` | `{\"checksums\": {key: sha256_hex}}` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `checksum` | 在不修改参数的情况下计算每个被校验参数的当前摘要。在重置权重之前将结果保存为基线。 | "
+"`{\"action\":\"checksum\"}` | `{\"checksums\": {key: sha256_hex}}` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `reset` | Zero the checked parameters to test the transfer path. The model"
+" cannot serve valid requests until its weights are restored. | "
+"`{\"action\":\"reset\"}` | `{\"status\":\"reset\"}` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `reset` | 将被校验参数置零，以测试传输路径。在权重恢复之前，模型无法处理有效请求。 | `{\"action\":\"reset\"}` "
+"| `{\"status\":\"reset\"}` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"| `compare` | Compute current digests and compare them with the baseline "
+"supplied by the caller. | `{\"action\":\"compare\",\"baseline\":{key: "
+"sha256_hex}}` | `{\"match\":bool,\"mismatches\":[key]}` |"
+msgstr ""
+"| `compare` | 计算当前摘要，并与调用方提供的基线进行比较。 | "
+"`{\"action\":\"compare\",\"baseline\":{key: sha256_hex}}` | "
+"`{\"match\":bool,\"mismatches\":[key]}` |"
+
+msgid ""
+"A checksum key has the form `dp{dp}:pp{pp}:pcp{pcp}:tp{tp}:{tensor_name}`,\n"
+"so each shard is checked separately. Expert-parallel ranks are identified by\n"
+"their DP/PCP/TP coordinates; there is no separate `ep` field. The server does\n"
+"not retain the baseline between requests: save the `checksum` response and\n"
+"pass its `checksums` object to `compare`."
+msgstr ""
+"校验键的格式为 `dp{dp}:pp{pp}:pcp{pcp}:tp{tp}:{tensor_name}`，因此每个分片都会被单独校验。专家并行 "
+"rank 通过其 DP/PCP/TP 坐标来标识；不存在单独的 `ep` 字段。服务器不会在请求之间保留基线：请保存 `checksum` "
+"的响应，并将其中的 `checksums` 对象传给 `compare`。"
+
+msgid ""
+"The standard check transfers the *same original weights* after `reset` and\n"
+"expects `compare` to report a full match. An old baseline should not match\n"
+"weights changed by a real training step. This procedure validates the\n"
+"weight-transfer path, not the correctness of newly trained weights."
+msgstr ""
+"标准检查会在 `reset` 之后传输*相同的原始权重*，并期望 `compare` "
+"报告完全匹配。旧基线不应与经过真实训练步骤修改后的权重匹配。此流程验证的是权重传输路径，而不是新训练权重的正确性。"
+
+msgid "#### Example"
+msgstr "#### 示例"
+
+msgid ""
+"Use an installed vLLM-Ascend environment with compatible vLLM, CANN and\n"
+"TorchNPU, including the compiled Ascend custom operators. The paired vLLM\n"
+"must provide the Weight Checker API and the weight-transfer trainer API used\n"
+"below. Use the dependency versions selected by your vLLM-Ascend checkout;\n"
+"changing only `PYTHONPATH` does not install its custom operators."
+msgstr ""
+"请使用已安装的 vLLM-Ascend 环境，并确保其 vLLM、CANN 和 TorchNPU 版本兼容，且包含已编译的昇腾自定义算子。配套的 "
+"vLLM 必须提供 Weight Checker API 以及下文使用的权重传输 trainer API。请使用你的 vLLM-Ascend "
+"代码检出所选择的依赖版本；仅修改 `PYTHONPATH` 并不会安装其自定义算子。"
+

+"This example needs two available NPUs, `curl`, `jq`, and the full\n"

+"consistently with two available physical devices. Do not use dummy weights\n"
+"or change the model's layer count for this checkpoint round trip."

+" 往返过程中，请勿使用虚拟权重或更改模型的层数。"
+
+msgid ""
+"In terminal 1, start the server on physical NPU 0 and wait until\n"
+"`curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health` succeeds:"

+"在终端 1 中，在物理 NPU 0 上启动服务器，并等待\n"
+"`curl -fsS http://127.0.0.1:8000/health` 成功："
+
+msgid ""
+"In terminal 2, save the following as `weight_checker_trainer.py`. It uses the\n"
+"same trainer API as\n"
+"[`rlhf_http_hccl.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/rl/rlhf_http_hccl.py),\n"
+"but waits for the reset and leaves generation paused after the transfer.\n"
+"Do not run that standalone example in the middle of this procedure: it\n"
+"requests generation before the transfer and resumes before checksum comparison."
+msgstr ""
+"在终端 2 中，将以下内容保存为 `weight_checker_trainer.py`。它使用与\n"
+"[`rlhf_http_hccl.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/blob/main/examples/rl/rlhf_http_hccl.py)\n"
+"相同的 trainer API，但会等待重置，并在传输完成后保持生成暂停。请勿在此流程中途运行该独立示例：它会在传输之前请求生成，并在校验和比较之前恢复生成。"
+
+msgid ""
+"Run it with both devices visible, and wait for the `Trainer ready` prompt\n"
+"before resetting the server. Leave this terminal waiting at the prompt:"
+msgstr "在两个设备均可见的情况下运行它，并等待出现 `Trainer ready` 提示后再重置服务器。让此终端停留在该提示处等待："
+
+msgid "In terminal 3, pause generation and save the original checksums:"
+msgstr "在终端 3 中，暂停生成并保存原始校验和："
+
+msgid ""
+"The final command should print `true`. `baseline.json` contains the actual\n"
+"parameter names and SHA-256 digests. Its response has this shape (the values\n"
+"below are placeholders):"
+msgstr ""
+"最后一条命令应输出 `true`。`baseline.json` 包含实际的参数名称和 SHA-256 摘要。其响应格式如下（以下数值为占位符）："
+
+msgid "Reset the weights while generation remains paused:"
+msgstr "在生成保持暂停的情况下重置权重："
+
+msgid "Expected response:"
+msgstr "预期响应："
+
+msgid ""
+"Before restoring the weights, verify that comparison detects the reset.\n"
+"Save a reusable comparison request so that the same baseline is used for\n"
+"both checks:"
+msgstr "在恢复权重之前，验证比较操作能够检测到重置。保存一个可复用的比较请求，以便两次检查使用相同的基线："
+
+msgid ""
+"The final command should print `true`. Now press Enter in terminal 2 to\n"
+"transfer the *original checkpoint weights*, and wait for `Transfer complete`\n"
+"and a successful trainer exit. This step must not perform a training update\n"

+msgstr ""

+"complete` 以及 trainer 成功退出。此步骤不得执行训练更新或恢复生成。"

+msgid ""
+"Back in terminal 3, compare the restored weights with the saved baseline:"
+msgstr "回到终端 3，将恢复后的权重与保存的基线进行比较："
+
+msgid "Expected response after a successful restore:"
+msgstr "成功恢复后的预期响应："
+
+msgid ""
+"If `match` is `false`, inspect `mismatches` and restore the weights before\n"
+"serving requests. Resume generation only after a full match:"
+msgstr "如果 `match` 为 `false`，请检查 `mismatches` 并在处理请求之前恢复权重。仅在完全匹配后才恢复生成："
+
+msgid "Finally, verify that generation works again:"
+msgstr "最后，验证生成功能恢复正常："
+
+msgid "#### Automated checks"
+msgstr "#### 自动化检查"
+
+msgid ""
+"Run these commands from the repository root in the installed environment:"
+msgstr "在已安装的环境中，从仓库根目录运行以下命令："
+
+msgid ""
+"The unit tests cover worker integration and mocked HCCL behavior. The E2E\n"
+"suite needs two NPUs and the full `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` checkpoint. It covers\n"
+"checksum/reset/reload, packed and unpacked IPC/HCCL transfers, and TP=2/DP=2\n"
+"rank coverage. Its shared helpers live under `tests/e2e/common/rlhf/`.\n"
+"`VLLM_RL_TEST_DEVICE_INDEX` is a logical index into the visible device list;\n"
+"the trainer uses the next device. Check the pytest summary for skipped cases\n"
+"before claiming the full suite passed."
+msgstr ""
+"单元测试覆盖 worker 集成和模拟的 HCCL 行为。E2E 测试套件需要两个 NPU 和完整的 `Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B` "
+"checkpoint。它覆盖校验和/重置/重新加载、打包和非打包的 IPC/HCCL 传输，以及 TP=2/DP=2 的 rank "
+"覆盖。其共享辅助函数位于 `tests/e2e/common/rlhf/` 下。`VLLM_RL_TEST_DEVICE_INDEX` "

+
+msgid ""
+"Basic and TP/DP checksum cases use eager mode. Transfer cases use the shared\n"
+"RLHF helper's `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` configuration with capture size 1. Other\n"
+"graph configurations require separate validation."
+msgstr ""
+"基本和 TP/DP 校验和用例使用 eager 模式。传输用例使用共享 RLHF 辅助函数的 `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` 配置，capture"
+" size 为 1。其他图配置需要单独验证。"
+
+msgid "#### Operational constraints"
+msgstr "#### 运行约束"
+
+msgid ""
+"- Stay paused from `checksum` through `compare`. Weights are invalid between\n"
+"  `reset` and the transfer, and EPLB may move experts while serving. The\n"
+"  worker methods do not enforce the pause; the caller must do so.\n"
+"- Before `reset`, confirm that a recovery path is available: a working\n"
+"  weight-transfer configuration or a checkpoint that `reload_weights` can\n"
+"  restore. In RL mode, `rl_config.enabled=true` disables FRACTAL_NZ by setting\n"
+"  `weight_nz_mode=0`. In a non-RL deployment where `weight_nz_mode` remains\n"
+"  enabled, the weight-update transaction cannot start; checkpoint reload may\n"
+"  be needed to recover after `reset`.\n"
+"- If the transfer or comparison fails, keep generation paused and restore the\n"
+"  weights before resuming. The engine must be awake: sleep levels 1 and 2\n"
+"  release weight memory.\n"
+"- `reset` is a destructive development operation. Keep development endpoints\n"
+"  within a trusted access boundary and do not expose them to the public\n"
+"  internet."
+msgstr ""
+"- 从 `checksum` 到 `compare` 期间保持暂停。在 `reset` 与权重传输之间，权重是无效的，并且 EPLB 可能在服务过程中移动专家。worker 方法不会强制执行暂停；调用方必须自行保证。\n"
+"- 在 `reset` 之前，确认存在可用的恢复路径：可正常工作的权重传输配置，或可由 `reload_weights` 恢复的检查点。在 RL 模式下，`rl_config.enabled=true` 会通过设置 `weight_nz_mode=0` 禁用 FRACTAL_NZ。在非 RL 部署中，如果 `weight_nz_mode` 仍处于启用状态，则权重更新事务无法启动；在 `reset` 之后可能需要重新加载检查点才能恢复。\n"
+"- 如果传输或比较失败，请保持生成暂停，并在恢复之前还原权重。引擎必须处于唤醒状态：睡眠级别 1 和 2 会释放权重内存。\n"
+"- `reset` 是一种破坏性的开发操作。请将开发端点保持在可信的访问边界内，不要将其暴露到公共互联网。"
+
+msgid "#### Limitations"
+msgstr "#### 限制"
+
+msgid ""
+"In addition to the\n"
+"[upstream limitations](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/training/weight_checker/#limitations):"
+msgstr ""
+"除了\n"
+"[上游限制](https://docs.vllm.ai/en/latest/training/weight_checker/#limitations)之外："
+
+msgid ""
+"- Weights held as buffers rather than parameters, such as some quantization\n"
+"  repacking paths, are invisible to the checker.\n"
+"- MoE weights padded beyond the checkpoint shape may report false mismatches;\n"
+"  validate the behavior with the target model before relying on `compare`.\n"
+"- Ascend 310P has not yet been verified with the Weight Checker."
+msgstr ""
+"- 以缓冲区而非参数形式持有的权重（例如某些量化重打包路径）对检查器不可见。\n"
+"- 填充超出检查点形状的 MoE 权重可能会报告错误的失配；在依赖 `compare` 之前，请使用目标模型验证该行为。\n"
+"- 昇腾 310P 尚未通过 Weight Checker 验证。"
+
+msgid ""
+"`--return-sampling-mask` enables the feature and is disabled by default.\n"
+"`--logprobs-mode processed_logprobs` is required.\n"
+"The following example also uses `--tokens-only` to expose the token-in/token-out\n"
+"API and skip tokenizer initialization. Use `--enable-scale-out` instead to expose the\n"
+"same endpoint while retaining the normal serving setup and tokenizer.\n"
+"See [Tokens in, tokens out](#tokens-in-tokens-out) for serving details."
+msgstr ""
+"`--return-sampling-mask` 用于启用该功能，默认处于禁用状态。\n"
+"需要设置 `--logprobs-mode processed_logprobs`。\n"
+"以下示例还使用了 `--tokens-only` 来暴露 token-in/token-out\n"
+"API 并跳过 tokenizer 初始化。若要暴露\n"

-msgid ""
-"Like n-gram, Suffix Decoding can generate draft tokens by pattern-matching "

-"pattern-match against both the prompt and previous generations, (2) uses "
-"frequency counts to propose the most likely continuations, and (3) "
-"speculates an adaptive number of tokens for each request at each iteration "
-"to get better acceptance rates."

-"可以针对提示和先前生成的内容进行模式匹配，(2) 使用频率计数来提出最可能的续写内容，以及 (3) "
-"在每次迭代中为每个请求推测自适应数量的令牌，以获得更好的接受率。"
-
-msgid ""
-"Suffix Decoding can achieve better performance for tasks with high "
-"repetition, such as code-editing, agentic loops (e.g. self-reflection, self-"
-"consistency), and RL rollouts."
-msgstr "后缀解码在具有高重复性的任务上可以实现更好的性能，例如代码编辑、智能体循环（例如自我反思、自我一致性）和强化学习展开。"

 msgid "## Dynamic Speculative Decoding {: #dynamic-speculative-decoding }"
 msgstr "## 动态推测解码 {: #dynamic-speculative-decoding }"
 
-msgid ""
-"Dynamic Speculative Decoding adapts the number of draft tokens (K) at "
-"runtime, instead of always using a fixed `num_speculative_tokens`. This "
-"helps keep speculative decoding beneficial as concurrency and draft "
-"confidence change. vLLM Ascend currently provides two approaches:"
-msgstr ""
-"动态推测解码在运行时自适应调整草稿令牌数量（K），而不是始终使用固定的 "
-"`num_speculative_tokens`。这有助于在并发度和草稿置信度变化时，继续发挥推测解码的收益。vLLM Ascend 当前提供两种方案："
-
-msgid ""
-"- **Confidence-based verify length (DSpark / DFlash)**: adjust the per-request verify length from draft confidence. DSpark uses a dedicated confidence head; DFlash is **head-free** and uses `max(softmax(logits))` of the drafted token as a confidence proxy.\n"
-"- **Batch-size based (Autoregressive)**: select a shared K from concurrency ranges via `num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size`."
-msgstr ""
-"- **基于置信度的验证长度（DSpark / DFlash）**：根据草稿置信度调整每个请求的验证长度。DSpark 使用专用的 confidence head；DFlash 为 **head-free**，使用草稿令牌的 `max(softmax(logits))` 作为置信度代理。\n"
-"- **基于 Batch Size（自回归）**：通过 `num_speculative_tokens_per_batch_size` 按并发区间选择共享的 K。"
-
-msgid "### Confidence-based verify length (DSpark / DFlash)"
-msgstr "### 基于置信度的验证长度（DSpark / DFlash）"
-
-msgid ""
-"This approach adapts how many drafted tokens are verified per request. It "
-"can reduce verify cost when the drafter is less confident about later "
-"tokens, while still allowing longer speculation when confidence is high."
-msgstr ""
-"该方案按请求自适应调整参与验证的草稿令牌数量。当草稿模型对靠后位置的令牌信心较低时，可以降低验证开销；当信心较高时，仍可保留更长的推测长度。"
-
-msgid "#### How it works"
-msgstr "#### 工作原理"
-
-msgid ""
-"When `dynamic_spec_config.method` is set to `\"dspark\"` or `\"dflash\"`, "
-"the corresponding proposer:"
-msgstr "当 `dynamic_spec_config.method` 设置为 `\"dspark\"` 或 `\"dflash\"` 时，对应的提议者会："
-
-msgid ""
-"1. Runs the draft model as usual to produce up to `num_speculative_tokens` draft tokens.\n"
-"2. Estimates per-position acceptance likelihood for each request:\n"
-"   - **DSpark**: sigmoid output of the DSpark confidence head.\n"
-"   - **DFlash (head-free)**: `max(softmax(logits))` of the argmax draft token (no extra neural head).\n"
-"3. Periodically recomputes a shared per-request verify budget from those confidence scores.\n"
-"4. Allocates that budget across requests (each request keeps at least `min_verify_tokens`), so each request verifies only a prefix of draft tokens."
-msgstr ""
-"1. 按常规方式运行草稿模型，生成最多 `num_speculative_tokens` 个草稿令牌。\n"
-"2. 估计每个请求在各个位置上的接受可能性：\n"
-"   - **DSpark**：DSpark confidence head 的 sigmoid 输出。\n"
-"   - **DFlash（head-free）**：argmax 草稿令牌的 `max(softmax(logits))`（无需额外神经网络头）。\n"
-"3. 基于这些置信度分数，周期性重新计算共享的每请求验证预算。\n"
-"4. 将该预算分配给各个请求（每个请求至少保留 `min_verify_tokens`），使每个请求只验证一段草稿令牌前缀。"
-
-msgid ""
-"The resulting per-request verify lengths are consumed by the model runner "
-"when collecting draft tokens for the target-model verify step."
-msgstr "得到的每请求验证长度会在模型运行器收集目标模型验证阶段所用的草稿令牌时被消费。"
-
-msgid "#### Configuration"
-msgstr "#### 配置"
-
-msgid ""
-"Enable this approach through `additional_config.dynamic_spec_config`. See "
-"[Additional Configuration](../configuration/additional_config.md) for the "
-"full parameter reference."
-msgstr ""
-"通过 `additional_config.dynamic_spec_config` "
-"启用该方案。完整参数说明请参见[附加配置](../configuration/additional_config.md)。"
-
-msgid ""
-"You still need a matching `speculative_config` (`method: \"dspark\"` or "
-"`\"dflash\"`, draft model path, and `num_speculative_tokens`). Dynamic "

-"`speculative_config`."

-msgid "## Draft KV Sliding Window {: #draft-kv-sliding-window }"
-msgstr "## 草稿KV滑动窗口 {: #draft-kv-sliding-window }"
-
-msgid ""
-"Draft models are often trained on short contexts (e.g. 4-8k tokens). When the\n"
-"running context grows far beyond that, the draft's attention goes\n"
-"out-of-distribution and the acceptance rate collapses — speculation turns\n"
-"into overhead. The **draft KV sliding window** caps only the *draft model's*\n"
-"attention to the most recent `draft_window_size` tokens. The target model\n"
-"still attends to the full context, so output quality is unchanged."
-msgstr ""
-"草稿模型通常在短上下文（例如4-8k个token）上训练。当运行上下文远超该范围时，草稿模型的注意力会超出分布范围，接受率骤降——投机解码反而变成开销。**草稿KV滑动窗口**仅限制*草稿模型*的注意力到最近的`draft_window_size`个token。目标模型仍然关注完整上下文，因此输出质量不变。"
-
-msgid ""
-"Enable it through `--additional-config` with any of the `eagle3`, `dflash`,\n"
-"and `dspark` methods:"
-msgstr "通过`--additional-config`配合`eagle3`、`dflash`和`dspark`方法启用："
-
-msgid "For offline inference, pass the same key inside `additional_config`:"
-msgstr "对于离线推理，在`additional_config`中传入相同的键："
-
-msgid ""
-"`additional_config` is forwarded to `EngineArgs` like the other engine\n"
-"options."
-msgstr "`additional_config`与其他引擎选项一样被转发到`EngineArgs`。"
-
-msgid ""
-"- **`draft_window_size`** (int, optional): the number of most recent tokens\n"
-"  the draft attention can read. Omit the key (or remove it) to disable the\n"
-"  window. Typical values are 512-4096; the window is block-aligned internally,\n"
-"  so any positive value works.\n"
-"- Works on the default model runner (MRV1). Not yet supported under\n"
-"  `VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`.\n"
-"- For `mtp` the window is ignored (force-disabled): MTP reuses the target\n"
-"  model's own layers, so windowing it would change the target's computation."
-msgstr ""
-"- **`draft_window_size`**（int，可选）：草稿注意力可以读取的最近token数量。省略该键（或删除它）以禁用窗口。典型值为512-4096；窗口在内部按块对齐，因此任何正值都有效。\n"
-"- 适用于默认模型运行器（MRV1）。在`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`下尚不支持。\n"
-"- 对于`mtp`，窗口被忽略（强制禁用）：MTP复用目标模型自身的层，因此对其加窗口会改变目标模型的计算。"
-
-msgid "### When to enable it"
-msgstr "### 何时启用"
-
-msgid ""
-"- **Enable** when the draft was trained on short contexts and acceptance\n"
-"  degrades as conversations grow: e.g. an early GLM-5.2 DSpark draft dropped\n"
-"  from mean acceptance ~5 (short context) to ~1 at 32k; a 512-1024 window\n"
-"  restored it to ~4.7-5.5, with end-to-end throughput up to +381% at 32k.\n"
-"- **Leave it off** when the draft is already stable at long context — the\n"
-"  window then only removes information the draft could have used. In\n"
-"  particular, if the draft itself was trained with sliding-window attention\n"
-"  (its config carries a native `sliding_window`), keep\n"
-"  `draft_window_size` at or above that training window, or disable the\n"
-"  feature; a window smaller than the training window measurably reduces\n"
-"  acceptance (observed -4.5% mean acceptance for a 1024 window against a\n"
-"  2048-native SWA DSpark draft at 32k input)."
-msgstr ""
-"- **启用**当草稿在短上下文上训练且随着对话增长接受率下降时：例如，早期的GLM-5.2 DSpark草稿在32k时平均接受率从约5（短上下文）下降到约1；512-1024的窗口将其恢复到约4.7-5.5，在32k时端到端吞吐量提升高达+381%。\n"
-"- **关闭**当草稿在长上下文下已经稳定时——此时窗口只会移除草稿本可以使用的信息。特别是，如果草稿本身使用滑动窗口注意力训练（其配置带有原生的`sliding_window`），请将`draft_window_size`保持在该训练窗口或以上，或禁用该功能；小于训练窗口的窗口会显著降低接受率（在32k输入下，1024窗口对比2048原生SWA DSpark草稿观察到平均接受率下降-4.5%）。"
-
-msgid ""

-msgid ""
-"1. The draft model runs the block in one forward pass. Its decoder layers\n"
-"   wrap the attention and MLP sublayers with learned block-causal grouped\n"
-"   convolutions that mix information across the K+1 query positions.\n"
-"2. The draft's hidden states go through the **target model's LM head**\n"
-"   (shared, unquantized): the full-vocabulary logits are top-k'd per draft\n"
-"   position, giving `selector_top_k` candidate tokens per step.\n"
-"3. A **candidate selector** head scores every edge of the candidate lattice:\n"
-"   a per-candidate unary logit plus a bilinear term between predecessor and\n"
-"   successor token codebooks and the projected hidden state.\n"
-"4. A path walk picks the highest-scoring chain of candidates starting from\n"
-"   the anchor token — greedily on the default model runner, or with\n"
-"   Gumbel-max sampling at the request temperature on model runner V2. On V2\n"
-"   the selected path's scores are also scattered back into full-vocabulary\n"
-"   draft logits for the rejection sampler."
-msgstr ""
-"1. 草稿模型在一次前向传播中运行该块。其解码器层用学习到的块因果分组卷积\n"
-"   包裹注意力和 MLP 子层，从而在 K+1 个查询位置之间混合信息。\n"
-"2. 草稿的隐藏状态经过**目标模型的 LM head**\n"
-"   （共享、未量化）：对全词表 logits 按每个草稿位置取 top-k，\n"
-"   得到每步 `selector_top_k` 个候选 token。\n"
-"3. **候选选择器**头为候选格的每条边打分：\n"
-"   每个候选的一元 logit，加上前驱与后继 token 码本之间\n"
-"   以及投影隐藏状态之间的双线性项。\n"
-"4. 路径游走从锚点 token 开始，选出得分最高的候选链 ——\n"
-"   在默认模型运行器上为贪心，或在模型运行器 V2 上按请求温度进行\n"
-"   Gumbel-max 采样。在 V2 上，所选路径的分数还会被散射回全词表\n"
-"   草稿 logits，供拒绝采样器使用。"

-msgid "## Block Verification in Model Runner V2"
-msgstr "## Model Runner V2 中的块验证"
-
-msgid ""
-"Model Runner V2 supports upstream vLLM's block verification for speculative "
-"decoding. It jointly verifies a block of draft tokens using cumulative "
-"target-to-draft probability ratios and samples a recovery token from the "
-"corresponding residual distribution. This can increase the accepted draft "
-"length while preserving the target sampling distribution. Performance gains "
-"depend on the draft model and workload."
-msgstr ""
-"Model Runner V2 支持上游 vLLM 针对投机解码的块验证。它使用累积的目标与草稿概率比值对一组草稿 token "
-"进行联合验证，并从相应的残差分布中采样一个恢复 token。这可以在保持目标采样分布的同时提高被接受的草稿长度。性能收益取决于草稿模型和工作负载。"
-
-msgid ""
-"Model Runner V2 is enabled by default (`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`). To "
-"enable block verification, set `\"rejection_sample_method\": \"block\"` in "
-"`speculative_config`, alongside your existing proposer settings. The default"
-" remains `\"standard\"`; omit this field or set it to `\"standard\"` to "
-"disable block verification."
-msgstr ""
-"Model Runner V2 默认启用（`VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=1`）。要启用块验证，请在 "
-"`speculative_config` 中设置 `\"rejection_sample_method\": \"block\"`，并保留现有的 "
-"proposer 设置。默认值仍为 `\"standard\"`；省略该字段或将其设置为 `\"standard\"` 即可禁用块验证。"
